source: Ure Awu Jesus Rore Jiboe Makore Jiboe Bu Bapera Keje João Batista Ure Boe Ewie Pao Kurirewu Bataruji
Pao Kurirewu o bakaru pemegarewu reo. Jesus Cristo jire Pao Kurirewu akoino. Onaregedunure ema.

Marigudu rugadu imedu Isaías ure Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Ainore nowu bataru akore Imode itugare utudo uwo boe pemegado nowu umode boe ekinorudowu togi. – Itugare kudugodumode boe ewagai boe maerewu keje boe ewo awara jetorodo boe eimijera kurirewu aregodumode boe etae duji. Mare awara ji karega inagoino. Boe ewo turo pemegado. Dujire inagoino.

Nou Pao Kurirewu makore jiboe jeture pudui rugadu. João Batista jirabodu Pao Kurirewu akoino. Pao Kurirewu utugarenure ema. Aregodure boe maerewu ka. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai. Ure boe etao pegodo. Akore tagera ra taro pegarewu piji dukeje imode tagao pegodo. Nono Pao Kurirewu biagodumode taro pegarewu piji.

Boe eture João ae. Emagare tudu tabo toro ae. Etaregodure Judéia moto piji. Etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji jamedu. Emearudure João Batista bataru ji dukeje emagore turo pegarewuji, taiduie tuwo tugera ra nowu turo pegarewu piji. Nono João Batista ure etao pegodo Jordão Po tada.
João Batista ukudaure camelo buce. Pegajejewure tapira biri rema. Okwagere tu kitariga dogei, ropa doge eweguruji tu rugadu.

Nono ure boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Akore ia imedu ro kodumode ikoriwu aregodumode iregodaji. Boe pemegarewunure ema, boe kurirewu mode ema rugadu. Dukodire ipogurumode ipureduwo ji iro rakakare kodi. Imire ire boe etao pegodo pobo tabo. Emare umode Tuwari tugu boe emearudaeto boe ero pemegawo.
João Ure Jesus Ao Pegodo
Ia meri keje Jesus uture tuwai piji Nazaré ba kurirewu piji toro Galiléia moto ka. Nono aregodure João Batista ae toro Jordão Po ka. Nonore João ure Jesus ao pegodo Jordão Po tada.
Nono Jesus ure tudawuje Jordão Po piji dukeje aiwore baru to. Nono barure tuiado dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje baru piji. Ure tudo nono metugore. Ure tumugudo Jesus keje.
Nono Pao Kurirewu makore baru piji. Akore itonaregedunure aki. Imearudu kurire ai rugadu. Are iagaredo i rugadu.
Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Jesus utudo toro boe maerewu ka.

Meri oto padure quarenta Jesus ji nono. Bope doge eimijera Satanás aregodure ae nono. Aidure tuwo turokogado Jesus ji tuwo Jesus mearudae pegado nono tumearudae mogadure. Barege pegarewuge emagare nono Jesus apo. Mare Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge etaregodure ae. Etu pemegare Jesus ji rugadu.
Jesus Makore Uwogurewuge Ewagai
Boe eimijera pegarewu ure João Batista tugu baicorewuto. Jesus uture Galiléia moto ka. Nonore makore Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu ji boe ewiagai.
Akore kuri aino Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo imi rugadu. Ca tagera ra taro pegarewu piji. Tamearutorudo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu.
Jesus merure pobo maerewu okwaji. Nou pobo maerewu iere Galiléia. Nono Jesus jorudure imei. Ere pobe. Ia iere Simão. Uwie iere André. Ewogure tuwuge tabo. Ere kare ewido.
Jesus makore etae. Akore mato tagoduwo itabo. Imode taruduwado tawoguwo ime ewagai. Mare tawogu ji karega inagoino. Tamode boe emearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dujire inagoino.
Nono ere tugera ra tuwogu piji taci je. Eture Jesus apo rugadu tumaragodae piji.

Jesus kodure nowu pobo maerewu okwaji kimo. Nono jorudure ia imei. Ere pobe. Ia iere Tiago. Nou uwie imedu iere João. Etuo iere Zebedeu. Eragojere to ika kurirewu tada. Emaragodure tuwugeji tuwo pemegado.
Jesus jorudure ei dukeje makore etae. Dukodire eture tuo piji, to ika kurirewu piji, tudugarege epiji tugoduwo Jesus apo.
Bope Meture Imedu Tada
Jesus aregodure Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowuge ebo. Sábado meri keje Jesus uture nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore ure boe eruduwado.

Boe emearudure Jesus bataru ji dukeje nono eiamedu boe eku kidure rugadu nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji. Jesus makore jiboe ukare nono nowu boe eimijerage joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ewadaru mogadure. Jesus mako pemegare mako jetorore rugadu dukodire boe eruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire Jesus akoino duji.
Nono ia bope meture tadawu imedu kudugodure. Nou bope uwari emare akoino.
Akore nazaré pijiwu Jesusnure aki rugadu. Nuba aromode cei? Amode cedagedudo na? Ceruduware ai. Aro pega bokware. Pao Kurirewu ure akarego mato tuwadaru pemegarewu tabo boe ewagai rugadu!
Nono Jesus makore nowu bope bataru jipagi. Akore amagokaba boe ji pugeje. Atawuje awu imedu piji.
Nou bope uwari ure nowu imedu magadudo ure kudugodudo jamedu. Dukejere ure tudawuje nowu imedu piji.

Boe erore ta je Jesus rore aino duji. Dukodire emagore pui. egore nuba awu Jesus rore? Ure nowu bope uwari utudo taci awu imedu piji. Nou bope mearutorure awu Jesus bataru ji. Marigudu ceruduwakare cerowo aino.
Dukodire boe ere nowu Galiléia moto kejewuge boe eiamedu boe ewie Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji jamedu.
Jesus Ure Boe Epemegago
Jesus uture nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai piji. Uture nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Tiago uture apo. João uture apo jamedu. Eture Simão, André ewai ka.
Simão ucarugo kogodure. Biri urure. Padure nono tuba keje. Jesus aregodure dukeje boe ere bie.
Dukodire uture ae. Ure tugeragu ieraji. Ure rakojedo dukeje nowu biri uru akedure taci je. Pemegagodure pugeje. Dukodire ure eke pemegado.
Boecoji boe etaregodure Jesus ae kogodurewugebo, bope doge emedure tadawugebo jamedu.
Nou mugure ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe etaregodure Jesus ae.
Jesus ure nowu kogodurewuge epemegago. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji tuwo etudo epiji rugadu. Nou bope doge eruduware Jesus ji dukodire Jesus ure nowu bope doge emago bokwado.
Jesus Makore Pao Kurirewu Bataruji Galiléia Moto Keje
Nou barogwato boedugu kimoto Jesus ure tudawuje. Uture nowu bai piji. Uture nowu ba kurirewu piji toro ia boe maerewu ka tumagowo Tuo bagai baru to.
Nono Simão uture tumedagebo tiemaru tabo bagai.
Nono erudure ji dukeje egore boe emarure awagai tumearuduwo awadaru ji pugeje.
Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore emearudure iwadaru ji marigudu dukodire padumode ia boe etae pugeje. Imagomode Iogwa Kurirewu bataru ji ewiagai jamedu. Dukodire itaregodure baru piji.
Dukodire uture Galiléia moto jamedu boe parugajeje tumagowo Tuo bataru ji boe ewiagai. Makore boe ji ere bato puiwu bai tada. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji jamedu.
Jesus Ure Imedu Pemegago Pugeje

Ia imedu kogodurewu aregodure Jesus ae pugeje. Nou kogodae ure biri pegado rugadu. Aregodure Jesus ae dukeje ure tubu jodo moto keje jokorai. Okwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera maku pudai rugadu. Akore aragare rugadu awo ipemegago. Mare akaidumode dukeje amode ipemegago.
Jesus okudugodure apo. Dukodire ure tugera bu nowu imedu keje. Akore uu. Itaidure. Ca. Apemegare rugadu.
Nono nowu imedu biri pemegagodure taci je rugadu.

Nono Jesus ure tumago rakado ji ukawo boe ewie nowu turore jiboe ji. Akore amagokaba awu irore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Atudo kuri nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai ka. Nonore amode nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwu imedu jorududo awiriji. Jorudumode awiri pemegagodure duji rugadu. Nono amode nowu Moisés makore jiwu mori maku ai rugadu nono paro mogadure. Nono nowu ure boe enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwu imedu umode nowu are maku pudaiwu mori maku Pao Kurirewu ai rugadu. Dukodire boe eiamedu boe eruduwamode apemegagodure duji. Jesus makore aino tuwo nowu imedu utudo pugeje.

Nou imedu uture mare mearutorukare Jesus makore pudui jiboe ji. Makore boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nuba Jesus rore pudui duji. Nono boe eiamedu boe etaidure tumagowo Jesus ji. Dukodire Jesus roiwakare tuduwo boe eda ka. Rakojere boe maerewu keje. Mare nowu moto kejewu boe emarure Jesus bagai tuioruduwo ji.
Jesus Ure Imedu Pogora Pegarewu Pemegago
Ia meri keje Jesus uture tuibagi Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka. Aregodure dukeje boe ere pu rugadu boe bie aregodure duji.

Dukodire boe eture nowu Jesus rakojere tadawu bai ka. Emagare. Emagare rugadu. Ere turemo nowu baito mare nowu bai cekare nowu boe dogei. Dukodire iage edure bawadu keje. Jesus makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji ewiagai.
Nono ia ime etaregodure. Enodo padure pobe puibiji. Enoredure ia imedu pogora pegarewu apo. Etaidure taregoduwo apo Jesus ae.

Mare boe emagare nono Jesus apo dukodire eroiwakare tubureduwo Jesus ji. Dukodire erudure nowu bai ao ka nowu imedu pogora pegarewu apo. Nono ere nowu bai ao porodo. Dukejere ere nowu imedu pogora pegarewu rawuje nowu bai ao piji moto ka bukigu tabo. Nou imedu padure kodo keje. Ere bukigu kogudo nowu imedu padure kejewu kodo tabo. Dutabore ere rawuje moto ka Jesus jokora ka.

Jesus jorudure emearutorure pudui duji kodire etaregodure aino nowu imedu apo pudae duji. Dukodire makore nowu imedu pogora pegarewuji. Akore me. Ire aro pegarewu jamedu boe barigu apiji dukodire Pao Kurirewu biagodumode aro pegare jiboe piji.
Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge edure nono nowu boe dogebo. Ewiapagare Jesus bataru ji dukeje emearudaere tudada.

egore awu Jesus makore jiboe ukare turugadu. Unure tudo nono Pao Kurirewure. Mare pagare akoino. Dukodire mako peganure Pao Kurirewu ji. Tu Pao Kurirewu umode boe ero pegarewu barigu boe epiji tuwiagoduwo ero pegarewu piji.
Jesus joruduware emearudaere jiboe ji. Dukodire makore ei. Akore kocare tamearudae pegare imagore jiboe ji.

Boe jokodu. Boe emodukare boe ero pegarewu barigu epiji rugadu. Mare boe emodukare awu imedu pogora pegarewu pemegago jamedu. Emodukare pemegago rugadu. Tu Pao Kurirewu umode pemegago. Tu Pao Kurirewu umode boe ero pegarewu barigu boe epiji tuwiagoduwo ero pegarewu piji rugadu.

Dukodire imode awu imedu pogora pegarewu pemegago dukeje taruduwamode Imedu Onaregedunure imi duji. Dukodire imode taruduwado iragare iwo boe ero pegarewu barigu epiji duji ewarigudukawo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto rugadu. Ainore Jesus akore nowu boe eimijeragei. Nono Jesus makore nowu imedu pogora pegarewuji.
Akore me. Aragojedo. Akeragu akudau kodoji atuwo tabo aibagi awai ka.

Boe etaiwore nowu imedu pogora pegarewuji. Ca ure turagojedo rugadu. Ure tugeragu tugudau kodoji. Dukejere uture tabo pugeje. Meru pegakare. Boe eiamedu boe eku kidugodure nowu rore aino duji. Dukodire emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. egore Marigudu cerudukare awu inoduji rugadu.
Jesus Makore Levi Bagai
Jesus uture tuibagi pobo maerewu okwa ka. Nou pobo maerewu iere Galiléia. Nou boe etaregodure nono ae pugeje. Emagare. Dukejere Jesus ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

Merure pobo okwaji dukeje jorudure imposto diero makudure aiwu imeduji. Nou imedu iere Levi. Alfeu onaregedunure ema. Mugure nono ira keje. Nonore ure tugeragu dieroji boe epiji enoe imposto morice tuwo maku boe eimijera kurirewu ai. Nou imedu maragodaenure nowu inoduce. Jesus makore ji. Akore ako itabo. Ca Levi ure turagojedo. Uture Jesus apo rugadu.

Nou boeco ji eragojere Levi uwai tada togwagewo. Jesus ure joruduwadowuge edure nono jamedu. Ia kodure Jesus apowuge emagare nono. Nou imposto mori makudure aiwuge edure nono jamedu. Boe egore ro pegarewuge enuie emage. Ia boe etaidukare jiwuge eragojere nono Jesus apo jamedu. Nou boe eiamedu boe emugure nono togwage tabo Jesus apo.

Dukejere ia fariseu doge etaregodure jamedu. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugenure emage. Erudure Jesus okwagere nowu ro pegarewugebo duji. Etaidukare nowu ro pegarewugei dukodire emagore nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ji. egore kocare Jesus okwagere awu ro pegarewugebo? Ukare turugadu!

Jesus mearudure nowu fariseu doge egoino duji. Dukodire makore ei. Akore jorubo kuru epa jemarumodukare kogodukarewuge ewagai. Mare kogodurewuge ewagaire jemarumode tuwo epemegago. Irore nono nowu jorubo kuru epa ro mogadure. Mare jorubo kuru epa ji karega inagoino. Itaregodure woe mare ro pemegarewuge ewagai karega iroino. Ro pegarewuge ewagaire iroino ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji. Dujire inagoino.
Boe Etaidure Jesus Okwage Bokwawo Ia Meri Keje

Ia meri keje aidure João Batista bataru jiwuge enogwage bokware tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to nowu meri ji. Ainore Fariseu doge erore jamedu. Ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje enarare ji. egore João Batista ure joruduwadowuge enogwagekare awu meri ji tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to awu meri ji. Fariseu doge ere joruduwadowuge erore aino awu meri ji jamedu. Kodiba are joruduwadowuge enogwagekare tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to awu meri ji?

Jesus akore Ire nono uwiremodewu imedu mogadure. Mare uwiremodewu karega. Boe etuwirere dukeje ere tuwadae towuje. Nou ewadae kejere boe enogwagemode rugadu. Ewadae reno. Ekiarigodumodukare nowu meri ji.

Mare ewadae akedure dukeje uwirerewu imedu utumode epiji toreduje apo. Dukejere care boe emode ia meri tawuje togwagekawo nowu meri ji tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to nowu meri ji. Ire nono nowu uwiremodewu imedu mogadure. Mare uwiremodewu imedu ji karega inagoino. Ire inagoino. Ire irawuje baru piji mato boe ewagai. Mare ia meri keje itumode nowu boe epiji baru to dukeje boe emode nowu meri tawuje togwagekawo nowu meri ji tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to nowu meri keje. Dujire inagoino.

Boe ekudau areia pegagodurewu umode tuwowuje. Mare boe emodukare tugudau areia maiwu kado tuwo nowu tugudau pegagodurewu poro miwuje tabo. Boe eromode aino dukeje nowu ekudau areia maiwu gigirimode. Dukodire umode tuwowuje nowu boe ekudau areia pegagodurewu piji kuri je pugeje. Dukodire nowu ekudau areia pegagodurewu umode tuwowuje ja je. Nono nowu poro kodumode tugori.

Boe ere tapira biri maiwu pemegado nowu tuge vinho kuru maiwu jace. Mare emode vinho kuru maiwu tugu tapira biri codurewuto dukeje nowu tapira biri codurewu umode tuwowuje. Nono nowu vinho kuru umode tuwarigu nowu tapira biri codurewu piji rugadu. Dukodire boe ekare tuge vinho kuru maiwu tugu tapira biri codurewuto. Ere tuge vinho kuru maiwu tugu tapira biri maiwuto tu tu je. Ainore Jesus akore. Mare areia ji karega akoino. Vinho kuru ji karega akoino. Tuwadaru maiwu jire Jesus akoino.
Boe Etaidure Tuioruduwawo Nuba Turomode Sábado Meriji
Jesus merure boepa oiagi sábado meri ji. Trigo ure nowu boepa tada. Ure joruduwadowuge ekodure apo. Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere tugeragu trigo enariji tuwo ko.

Fariseu doge emearudae pegare nowu inoduji. Dukodire emagore Jesus ji. egore akaiwodo. Judeu dogenure pagi. Pamaragodumodukare sábado meri ji. Dukodire pamodukare pageragu trigoji sábado meri keje. Mare nowu are joruduwadowuge ere tugeragu trigoji. Ukare turugadu! Mare eruduwakare. Boe ewo tugeragu ia tuge roguji ji karega Pao Kurirewu akoino boe emaragodukaiago sábado meri ji.

Jesus akore Taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji! Dukodire taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Taruduwamode Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji dukeje tamago pegamodukare ceroino duji. Marigudu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu Davi rore jiboe padure Pao Kurirewu bataru keje. Dujire taruduwakare. Nou Davi uke boeire ji. Utugarege tugobaigarege eke boeire ei jamedu.

Dukodire ure turemo Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Okwagere boe ere maku Pao Kurirewu aiwu amirewuji. Nou joruji nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu iere Abiatar. Pao Kurirewu ure turo maku pawobe Judeu doge etai. Makore ei ekawo nowu amirewu ko. Tu nowu ure boe enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge emode nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu amirewu kowuje. Mare Davi ure kowuje. Ure ia maku tudugarege etai ewo kowuje jamedu.

Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imire imode boe eruduwado rugadu nuba boe eromode sábado meri keje. Dukodire imagomode aino tai. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ero maku boe etai erowo aino sábado meri ji tu tu je. Mare paga karega boe pemegawo boe ji. Boe pegawo boe ji karega.
Imedu Iera Pegare
Jesus uture Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka pugeje sábado meri keje. Ia imedu rakojere nono. Iera pegare. Ierare tudorido puapo.

Ia boe erudu pegare Jesus ji. Edure nono jamedu. Dukodire etaiwore Jesus ia ro pegamode dubagai. Judeu doge eromodukare ia turore jiboe ji sábado meri keje. Dukodire etaidukare boe eiogowo boe ji sábado meri keje. Mare Jesus umode nowu imedu iera pemegago nowu meri ji dukodire nowu boe erudu pegamode Jesus rore aino duji.
Jesus makore nowu imedu iera pegarewuji. Akore aragojedo. Mato itae woe boe etoia ka.

Nono Jesus unarare nouia boe ji. Akore nuba pago bakaru akore paromoduie sábado meri keje? Paro pegamoduie boe ji kana? Paro pemegamoduie boe ji kana? Pamode boe ekinorudo boe pegarewu piji sábado meri keje kana? Pamode boe ewarigu boe pegarewuto sábado meri keje kana? Nou boe emagokare boe ji.

Jesus korigodure ei. Aiwore ei. Etaidukare tumearuduwo Jesus makore jiboe ji emearudae pegare kodi. Mare Jesus okudugodure ebo jamedu. Dukejere Jesus makore nowu imedu iera pegarewuji. Akore akera raido itae. Nono nowu imedu ure tugera raido ae. Care iera pemegagodure taci je.

Mare fariseu doge eture nowu bai piji tumara tabo boe korire ei kodi. Erudu pegare Jesus rore aino duji sábado meri keje. Sábado meri ji emaragodumodukare eromodukare ia turore jiboe ji. Dukodire ekorigodure Jesus ji. Ere bato pui ia mearutorure Herodes bataru jiwu imebo. Emagore pui tuwo ia tumearudae tawuje tuwo Jesus bito.
Boe Emagare Pobo Maerewu Po Okwai
Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo pobo maerewu okwa ka. Nou pobo maerewu iere Galiléia Po. Aidure Jesus bataru jiwuge eture Jesus rekodaji pugeje. Emagare rugadu.

Galiléia kejewugere. Judéia kejewugere. Iduméia kejewugere. Tiro ba kurirewu kejewugere. Sidom ba kurirewu kejewugere. Ia Jordão Po bakowu kejewuge ekurugodure Jordão Po kajeje taregoduwo Jesus ae jamedu. Emearudure Jesus rore jiboe ji dukodire nowu boe etaregodure tuioruduwo Jesus ji.

Boe ere tuiodo puwugeje pu otodai dukodire Jesus roiwakare tumago pemegawo ei. Dukodire makore ture joruduwadowugei ewo ia ika kurirewu po barigu tuwo taredo to. Ewo tuiodo ika keje pobo oiado. Nono akuamode tumago pemegawo nowu boe ji nowu ika piji.
Jesus ure kogodurewuge epemegago. Emagare rugadu. Mare ia kogodurewuge kimore. Etaidure tuwo tuburedo Jesus ji tuwo tugera jetudo Jesus ukudau areiaji tubemegagoduwo.
Bope doge emedure iage etada. Etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje ere tuwududo moto keje tugudu tabo Jesus jokorai. egore Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki!
Jesus mako rakare nowu bope doge ewadaru jipagi emagokawo nowu inoduji boe ewiagai.
Jesus Ure Tugeragu Tumode Joruduwadowugei Tuwo Etudo Tuwadaru Tabo Boe Ewagai
Nono Jesus ruture ia tori ao ka. Nono makore taidure jiwuge boe ewagai. Nono etaregodure ae.

Jesus ure tugeragu jiwuge ime enodo padure kejewugere doze. Ure tugie maku etai. Akore uture iwadaru tabowu boenure tagi. Ire ikeragu tai taragojewo itabo. Imode taruduwado tamagowo iboe ji boe ewiagai.
Imode taragado tawo bope doge etawuje boe epiji.
Ainore nowu Jesus ure tugeragu jiwuge ekiere. Ia iere Simão. (Jesus ure awu Simão iedo Pedro)
Ia iere Tiago. Zebedeu onaregedunure ema. Ia iere João. Tiago uwienure ema. (Jesus ure nowu ime pobedu doge ekiedo Boanerges. Ewadaru tabo egore aino: “Boeiaruru orenure emage.”)
Ia iere André. Ia iere Filipe. Ia iere Bartolomeu. Ia iere Mateus. Ia iere Tomé. Ia iere Tiago. Nou Tiago Alfeu onaregedunure ema. Ia iere Tadeu. Ia iere Simão Zelote.
Ia imedu iere Judas Iscariotes. Emare umode Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.
Boe Emago Pegare Jesus Rore jiboe ji
Nono Jesus ure turemo ia baito. Boe emagare nono apo pugeje. Dukodire Jesus roiwakare togwagewo ture joruduwadowugebo.
Jesus uwobe emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje etaidure tuwo Jesus utudo nowu boe doge epiji. Boe egore Jesus aora bai baie kodi.

Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji. Erudu pegare Jesus rore jiboe ji dukodire emago pegare ji. egore bope doge eimijera iere Belzebu. Emare meture nowu Jesus tada. Emare ure turaga maku Jesus ai Jesus uwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji.
Dukodire Jesus makore ewagai tumagowo ewadaru jipagi. Akore bope doge eimijera iere Satanás jamedu. Umodukare tudawuje boe epiji tuginai. Mare ia imedu ro rakarewu koiare umode tawuje boe epiji.
Ia boe epokare puapo dukeje erugodure pui. Dukeje eraga akedumode epiji kuri je.
Boe erugodumode tuwobei dukeje emode tugera ra pubiji rugadu. Dukodire eraga bokwamode rugadu.
Mare mearutorure Satanás jiwugeire inagoino. Epomodukare puapo dukeje eragamodukare pugeje. Boe pegamode ei rugadu. Etagedumode rugadu.

Ca iwogurewu aidure tuwo turemo ia tugobaigare uwaito tuwo tugeragu nowu tugobaigare ia oeji. Mare umode nowu tugobaigare kogudo bukigu tabo boeto ji. Nono umode tugeragu nowu tugobaigare oeji rugadu tuduwo tabo rugadu.

– Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe etaidukare turo pegarewu ji pugeje dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegarewu piji. Emago pegamode Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare ekiarigodumode nowu tuwadaru pegarewu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode ewadaru pegarewu piji.

Mare ia boe emago pegamode Pao Kurirewu Uwariji dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu ewadaru pegarewu piji rugadu. Nou bataru metumode nowu boebo ji rugadu. Du akedumodukare rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu inodu piji.
Nou boe egore bope uwari metuie Jesus tada dukodire Jesus akoino ei.
Jesus Uce, Uwiemage Etaregodure
Jesus uce, uwiemage etaregodure bagai. Eragojere bawadu keje. Emagore Jesus bagai toro nowu baito.
Boe emagare nowu bai tada Jesus apo. Emagore Jesus ji. egore akaiwodo. Ace, awiemage etaregodure. Epagare awagai bawadu keje.

Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore imode tawie iogudubanure mugace, iogudubanure iwobece. Nono Jesus aiwore nowu mugure pudabowuge ji. Akore awu boe ere nono iwobe mogadure. Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu mearudae jiwu areme ime ere nono iwobe emogadure rugadu. Ere nono iwie mage emogadure rugadu. Ere nono muga mage emogadure rugadu.
Boepa Tadaboe Jiwu Bakaru Reo

Nono Jesus uture nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa ka pugeje. Boe ere bato pui nono tumearuduwo Jesus bataru ji pugeje. Emagare rugadu. Dukodire Jesus ure taredo ia ika kurirewuto. Nou ika kurirewu padure nono pobo tada. Nou boe edure pobo okwai tumearuduwo Jesus bataru ji. Jesus ure tumugudo nowu ika kurirewu ja tada.
Nono Jesus makore ia bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai tuwo nowu boe eruduwado nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji.
Akore tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Ia meri keje imedu uture to boepato tuwo boe tugu mototo.
Ure boe a roto ja ja moto joki to boepa tada. Ia a buture awara okwaji. Dukodire kiebarege ere nowu buture awara okwa jiwu boe a rugadu kowuje.
Ia a buture toriguru tada. Boture kuri je mare moto pegare ji.
Dukodire boeru jeture ji dukejere nowu boeru ure nowu botureboe bito kuri je rugadu. Ukwa bokware kodi. Moto pegare kodi.
Ia a buture botoguru tada. Botoguru boture tabo jamedu mare botoguru ure bito. Dukodire nowu buture botoguru tadawu boe a ricodukare pemegakare jamedu.

Mare ia a buture moto pemegarewu keje. Ere tuguwu sacu ure mitotu je. Botu pemegare, ricodu pemegare, enari kurire rugadu. Kidure dukeje ere rawuje ciwu piji. Ere a rawuje tuwo tugu sacuto. Nou sacu doge emagare. Paruduwakare nuba nowu ere korau sacu dogere. Ere cem, ere sessenta, ere trinta rabodu nowu boe a tabo. Tawiapaga pemegado awu iwadaru ji taruduwawo kaba jiba inagoino tai.
Jesus ure nowu bakaru akedudo dukeje makore ei pugeje. Akore tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji.
Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Kodiba Tumagore Bakaruji Boe Ewiagai
Jesus uture nowu boe epiji ture joruduwadowugebo. Mare iage etaidure tuioruduwawo kaboba jiba nowu bakaru akoino. Dukodire eture rekodaji tumearudu pemegawo kaba jiba akoino.

Jesus makore ei. Akore ireadodure bakaruji iwo boe eruduwado nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Mare paga karega. Ireadodure bakaruji aino Pao Kurirewu uwo taruduwado meture pudabowu tumearudae boe ji boe ewo tugimijerado tu ema. Mare mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge emearudumode imagore jiwu bakaruji mare emodukare boe pa nowu bakaruji.

Dukodire: – Etaiwomode rugadu mare erudumodukare boe ji; Ewiapagamode mare eruduwamodukare boe ji. Mare eruduwamode dukeje emode tumagu Pao Kurirewu ai. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegarewu boe piji.
Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Eruduwado Tumagore Jiboe ji
Nono Jesus unarare ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore taruduware awu inagoino jiwu bakaruji? Nuba taromode taruduwawo awu bakaruji?
Nono Jesus ure eruduwado nowu bakaruji. Akore boe eire inagoino. Pao Kurirewu bataru jire inagoino jamedu.

Pao Kurirewu o bataru ure nono nowu boe a mogadure. Mare boe a ji karega inagoino. Pao Kurirewu bataru aregodumode boe etae. Nono boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dujire inagoino. Boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare bope doge eimijera umode nowu boe ewiagodudo nowu tumearudure jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru piji. Dukodire emearutorumodukare ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

Ia boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji pugeje. Nono nowu boe emode nono nowu boture toriguru tadawu boe a mogadure. Mare boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Nou boe eragamodukare tumearutoru raiwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dujire inagoino. Emode tugeragu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji tiagare tabo mare emearutoru raimodukare ji. Dujire inagoino.

Ia boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji pugeje. Awu boe emode nono nowu boture botoguru tadawu boe a mogadure. Botoguru umode boe pegado ji umode bito. Mare boture botoguru tadawu boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Nou boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Etaidure tumearutoruwo ji. Dujire inagoino.

Mare emororamagadumode tu tumearudae boe ji kuri je. Emearudaere tu pudui tuwo to diero kurido. Dujire inagoino. Etaidumode tu taidure jiboe ji. Emearudaere nowu taidure jiboe umode tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji mare pagatu je. Dukodire emode tugera ra Pao Kurirewu bataru piji. Dujire inagoino.

Mare ia boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorumode ji rugadu. Dukodire epemegamode rugadu nono nowu boture moto pemegarewu boe a mogadure. Mare boture moto pemegarewu kejewu boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Nou boe emearudumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nono emearutorumode ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Emodukare tugera ra tumearutorure jitu piji rugadu jii toro rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
Boe Emodukare Pori Bu Jorugu Aogeje

Jesus makore kimo. Akore boe emode pori bu lamparina aogeje dukeje urugumodukare. Boe emode jorugu mugudo tuba kuda dukeje urugumodukare jamedu. Mare boe emode lamparina urugu bararedo, uruguwo pudui.
Ca boe etaidumode tuwo turo pegarewu biado boe epiji. Mare Pao Kurirewu joruduware marigudu ero pegarewuji. Dukodire boe eruduwamode nowu ero pegarewu ji jamedu.
Taipaga pemegado iwadaru ji.

Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore taipaga pemegado tamearudure jiboe ji. Tagaiwomode boe eroji ero pegamode dubagai dukeje Pao Kurirewu aiwomode taro pegarewu bagai jamedu. Tagaidumode boe pegawo boe ji ero pegarewu morice dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado tai rugadu taro pegarewu morice.

Boe eruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Etaidure tumearutoruwo ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode eruduwa kurido pudui emearutoruwo pudui rugadu. Mare ia boe etaidumodukare tumearutoruwo tuioruduware jiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode eruduwa bokwado tuwadaru ji. Emearudaere tuioruduwaie rugadu mare pagatu je.
Boe A Boture Dukodiwu Bakaru Reo

Jesus makore boe ji pugeje. Akore boe eimijera kurirewunure Pao Kurirewuce rugadu. Mearutorure jiwuge emagamode rugadu. Mare boe eruduwakare mearutorumode jiwugei mearutorumodukare jiwugei jamedu. Imode taruduwado nowu inoduji bakaru tabo. Imedu ure boe a tugu mototo mare joruduwakare botumodewugei botumodukarewugei jamedu. Ure boe a roto ja ja moto joki.
Nono nudure boeco ji. Nou barogwato ure tie bu. Ure tuguwu boe a boture mare imedu jorudukare ji mototo. Joruduwakare nuba nowu boe a rore tuwoduwo.
Moto koiare ure nowu boe a botudo. Boture dukeje ricodure. Ricore dukeje enarire. Enari kurire.

Imedu pagare kuroduwo. Kurodumode dukeje ure kado tariga tabo. Inagore imedu uie boe a tugu mototo. Boere nono nowu boe a mogadure. Mare boe a ji karega inagoino. Boe eire inagoino. Ia boe emearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Iage emearutorumodukare ji jamedu.
Mostarda A Boture

Jesus makore boe ji pugeje. Akore itaidure iwo taruduwado nuba Pao Kurirewu utugarege ere. Pao Kurirewu utugarege emagakare mare ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu utugarege emagagodumode rugadu. Ireadoduwo ia bakaruji tawiagai.
Ia imedu ure ia mostarda a tugu to boepato. Mostarda a kurikare rugadu. Boe a jamedu boe kurire nowu mostarda a kori. Imedu ure tugu to boepato.

Nono ia meri keje boture. Ricodure rugadu. Nono iku kurire nowu boe emode tugu to boepa tadaboe iku jamedu boe kori. Kiebarege ere tumugudo keje. Ere tuwaradu pemegado keje. Pao Kurirewu utugarege ere nono nowu mostarda arogu mogadure. Mare mostarda a ji karega inagoino. Pao Kurirewu utugarege eire inagoino. Emagakare mare ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu utugarege emagamode rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
Ainore Jesus akore. Readodu kigodure bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai tuwo eruduwado toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji rugadu jii eruduwamode jitu oto pa ka.

Bakaru jire Jesus akoino boe ewiagai. Mare Jesus mugure nowu ture joruduwadowugebo tuginai dukeje ure nowu ture joruduwadowuge eruduwado nowu tumagore jiwu bakaruji ewiagai. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze.
Jesus Ure Bakuru Pegarewu Akedudo
Nou meri ji rugadu boeco ji Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore Pagurugoduwo awu pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka.
Dukodire emagore nowu boe ji etuwo pugeje. Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze. Ere taredo ika kurirewuto Jesus apo. Nono eture. Ia boe eture eregodaji ika kurirewugebo jamedu.

Ekurugodure dukeje bakuru pegarewu aregodure etae. Nou bakuru pegarewu ure pobo maerewu rutudo. Dukodire pobo jeture nowu ika kurirewuji. Dukodire pobo ure turemo nowu ika kurirewuto. Dukodire nowu ika kurirewu korobadugodure pobo tabo.
Mare Jesus unudure toro nowu ika kurirewu upo keje. Aora padure takudau keje. Ca ure joruduwadowuge ere Jesus jetadudo. egore cegimijera! Akaidure pawiwo? Pawimode!
Ca Jesus ure turagojedo. Nono mako rakare bakuruji. Akore akaguru akedudo! Nono makore poboji. Akore akaba aporudo pugeje! Dukodire nowu bakuru akedure rugadu. Nou pobo butugugodure jamedu.
Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore kodiba tabagudugodure? Kocare tamearutorukare i na?
Mare epagudugodure rugadu. Nono emagore pui. egore Dubobanure awu imeduce? Kocare bakuru, pobo emearutorure awu Jesus bataru ji rugadu!
Jesus Ure Bope Doge Etuwaire Tawuje Ia Imedu Piji
J e s u s a r e g o d u r e t u r e joruduwadowugebo toro nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa abowu ka. Nou etaregodure kawu moto iere Gerasa.
Nono Jesus ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji dukeje bope doge emedure tadawu imedu uture Jesus togi.
Dukodire nowu imedu mugure boe ere birewuge etugu tadawu tori poro tada. Boe etaidure tuwo nowu imedu kogudo meriri iku tabo mare meriri iku rakakare nowu imeduji.
Marigudu boe ere nowu imedu bure kogudo meriri iku tabo. Ere nowu imedu iera kogudo meriri iku tabo. Mare nowu imedu ure nowu meriri iku kado turaga tabo tu tu je. Raka kodure boe eiamedu boe ekori.
Nou imedu meru pagare tori aoji, nowu tori poro jamedu boe parugajeje meri ji boeco ji. Kudu pagare meri jamedu boe ji tu tu je. Ure tuwiri kado nowu tori mega tabo rugadu.
Nou imedu aiwo jaere Jesus togi. Nono rekodure toro ae. Aregodure Jesus ae dukeje ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai.

Dukejere ure tugudu rakado. Akore Jesusnure aki! Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki! Boe eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewunure Pao Kurirewuce! Jesus akore Bope uwarinure aki. Atawuje awu imedu piji! Nou bope uwari akore Nuba aromode cei? Akaba itudo boe pegarewuto. Amagodo Pao Kurirewu biagai aro pegamodukaie i rugadu.
Jesus unarare ji. Akore nuba akiere? Nou meture nowu imedu tadawu bope uwari akore Cegiere bope doge makarewuge. Cemagare awu imedu tada.
Nono nowu meture nowu imedu tadawu bope doge enogwamagudure Jesus ji ukawo tududo nowu moto piji.
Jugurewuge edu puredure togwage tabo nono.
Dukodire nowu meture nowu imedu tadawu bope doge enogwamagudure Jesus ji nowu imedu ja piji. egore cedudo toro nowu jugurewuge etae. Cedo ceremo nowu jugurewugeto.

Nono Jesus ure etudo. Dukodire nowu bope doge ere tudawuje nowu imedu piji. Ere turemo nowu jugurewugeto. Dukodire nowu jugurewuge eiamedu boe eregodure kuri ia moto ri ao piji taci poboto. Dukodire eiamedu boe ewire poboto. Enodo padure dois mil.

Nou jeture nowu jugurewuge eiwuge ime eregodure nowu boe epiji toro tuwai mugure tadawu ba kurirewu ka. Ereadodure Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu ba kurirewu tadawu boe ewiagai. Ereadodure boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje jamedu. Dukodire nowu boe eture Jesus ae tuioruduwo ji, tuioruduwo nowu imeduji jamedu.

Etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje erudure nowu bope doge emedure tadawu imeduji pemegagodure duji. Butugugodure. Ukudau areia meture ji. Eruduware ji. Eruduware Jesus ure bope doge etawuje nowu imedu piji dukodire nowu imedu pemegagodure. Dukodire nowu boe epagudugodure.
Jorudure nowu Jesus rore jiwuge ereadodure nouia boe ewiagai nuba Jesus rore nowu bope doge emedure tadawu imeduji. Ereadodure nowu bope doge ere turemo jugurewugeto duji nouia boe ewiagai jamedu.
Nou boe epagudugodure dukodire enogwamagudure Jesus ji utuwo nowu to moto piji.
Dukodire Jesus uiago taredo ika kurirewuto pugeje. Mare nowu bope doge ere tudawuje pijiwu imedu okwamagudure Jesus ji. Akore itaidure ikoduwo akabo.
Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore boro. Atudo aibagi awobe etae. Areadoduwo ewiagai nuba Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare ai duji rugadu. Areadodudo ewiagai Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare ai du boe ji.

Dukodire nowu imedu uture Jesus piji tuwobe etae. Boe eda enodo padure dez nowu moto keje. Nou imedu readodure Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare pudui duji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe eiamedu boe erore ta je nowu imedu akoino tureadodu tabo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai duji.
Jesus Ure Ia Areme Epemegago
Jesus kurugodure nowu pobo maerewu kajeje tuibagi. Aregodure toro dukeje boe emagare nono pobo okwai.
Judeu doge ere bato pui ia bai tada tu tu je. Jeture nowu bai jiwu boe eimijera iere Jairo. Nou imedu Jairo aregodure Jesus togi. Dukejere ure tuwududo moto keje Jesus jokorai.
Dukejere okwamagudure Jesus ji. Akore itonaregedu aredu bigodunure. Mato itabo awo akera bu biri keje pemegagoduwo, bikawo.
Dukodire Jesus uture nowu Jairo apo. Boe emagare rugadu tugodui Jesus rekodaji dutabo. Nono nowu boe emagare rugadu dukodire ere taiado paci Jesus apo.

Ia aredu kodure ebo Jesus rekodaji. Marigudu nowu aredu kogodaere tu tu je. Nou aredu ku rere piji nono areme etorewudae mogadure. Mare nowu aredu o akedukare piji. Re kimore piji meri jamedu boe ji. Joru oto padure doze nowu aredu ku rere piji dukeje. Kodire uture jorubo epage etae. Ure diero rugadu maku jorubo epage etai mare ekare nowu aredu pemegago. Pegare kimo. Jorubo epage etaiwore ji dukeje nowu kogodae ure turagado ji rugadu.

Nou aredu mearudure Jesus rore jiboe ji. Dukodire uture ae. Mare boe emagare nono Jesus apo. Dukodire nowu aredu makore tudada. Akore ikera otorogu jetumode awu Jesus ukudau areiaji dukeje ipemegagodumode. Nono nowu aredu ure tugera raido. Nono iera otorogu jeture Jesus ukudau areiaji.
Ca nowu aredu pemegagodure taci je. Nou aredu ku rekare piji pugeje. Joruduware tubemegagodure duji rugadu.
Ca Jesus joruduware ia turaga iogore ia boe ji duji. Dukodire ure tuwuredo taiwowo nowu boe ji. Akore ioguduba ure tugera raido ikudau areia ka?
Nou ure joruduwadowuge emagore ji. egore kodiba akagore aino? Boe emagare woe pagabo. Boe eiamedu boe ekera jeture akudau areiaji.
Mare Jesus aiwore nowu boe ji nowu iera jeture tugudau areia jiwu bagai.
Nou aredu joruduware tubemegagodure duji. Dukodire ure tuburedo Jesus ji. Mare pagudure dukodire mororamagadure. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai dukejere readodure turore jiboe ji Jesus biagai.
Jesus makore ji. Akore are. Amearutorure i dukodire apemegagodure. Amororamagadukaba. Ire akogodae akedudo apiji rugadu.
Jesus mako kimore nowu areduji dukeje ime etaregodure etae Jairo uwai piji. Emagore Jairoji. egore akanaregedurogu bokware. Amagokaba nowu pagimijeraji pugeje. Piji.
Jesus mearudure emagore jiboe ji mare biapagakare ewadaru ji. Makore Jairoji. Akore amororamagadukaba. Amearutorudo i rugadu.
Nono uture Jairo apo, Pedro apo, Tiago apo, Tiago uwie João apo. Eture toro Jairo uwai ka. Mare nouia ture joruduwadowuge ukare etudo pudabo. Kodire etukare rugadu.
Jesus aregodure Jairo uwai ka Pedro apo, Tiago apo, João apo dukeje erudure boe ji nono. Nou boe etragudu rakare. Ekiarigodure rugadu etonaregedu bire kodi.
Nono Jesus ure turemo tumagowo ei. Akore kodiba tagragudure? Kodiba tagiarigodure? Aredu bikare. Unudunure! Joruduware tumoduie jewodudo pugeje. Dukodire akoino unudunuie.

Mare nowu boe eruduware nowu nogwaredu bire rugadu duji dukodire enogwarigodure Jesus ji. Dukodire Jesus ure etudo nowu bai piji. Nono ure tugeragu nowu aredu uceji, ure tugeragu aredu uoji. Ure tugeragu Pedro ji, Tiagoji, Joãoji jamedu. Nono ure turemo ebo nowu aredu padure tadawu baito.
Jesus ure tugeragu nowu aredu ieraji dukeje makore ji ewadaru tabo. Akore talitá cumi! (Boe ewadaru tabo akore are! Amugudo! Imire inagoino ai!)
Ca nowu aredu ure tumugudo taci je. (Nou aredu o joru oto padure doze.) Nono ure turagojedo. Merure nowu bai ja tada. Uce, uo erore ta je.
Nono Jesus makore ei ekawo boe ewie turore jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Dukejere Jesus akore awu tagonaregedu okwagedo.
Nazaré Ba Kurirewu Kejewuge Etaidukare Jesus ji
Jesus uture Jairo uwai piji tuduwo turijodure kejewu Nazaré ba kurirewu ka. Ure joruduwadowuge eture rekodaji.

Sábado meri ji Jesus uture Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore ure boe eruduwado nowu bai tada. Nono boe emagare nowu bai tada jamedu. Emearudure Jesus bataru ji dukodire erore ta je. Mare erudu pemegakare ji. egore awu Jesus maragodumode ira jiwu imedunure ema. Boe eimijera karegure ema. Ceruduware uwobe eiamedu boe ji. Uce iere Maria. Uwie ime ekiere Tiago, José, Judas, Simão. Uwie areme emugu kimore woe awu pago ba kurirewu keje rugadu. Ioguduba ure awu imedu joruduwado? Ioguduba ure turaga maku ai ro rakawo awu turo rakarewu boe ji? Boe eimijera karegure ema. Boe eimijera ukare joruduwado. Pagare akoino. Ro rakare mare pagatu je. Nono nowu boe emearutorukare Jesus ji.

Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu makore jiboe pemegamode boe ji. Boe emearutorumode ji. Mare turijodure kejewu boe eda kejewuge etaidumodukare makore jiboe ji. Uwobe uwai tadawu boe etaidumodukare makore jiboe ji. Tu emage rugadu. Iage etaidumode ji.

Boe emearutorukare Jesus ji nono. Dukodire Jesus roiwakare tuwo turo rakarewu makado nono nowu turijodure kejewu moto keje. Akore kocare awu boe emearutorukare i. Ure ia boe epemegago. Mare emagakare. Ure tugera bu ewugeje dukeje ure epemegago rugadu. Nono Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Aregodure ia boe eda ka pugeje. Nono ure boe eruduwado pugeje.
Jesus Ure Tumaragodae Maku Ture Joruduwadowuge Etai.

Nono makore ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Enodo padure doze. Jesus aidure tuwo etudo tuwadaru tabo boe eiamedu boe etae. Ure edo pobe tu tu puapo boe etae. Ure eragado ewo bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji.

Akore tadukaba tage tabo. Tadukaba diero tabo. Tagaba tagoroe reko jamedu. Tadukaba ia tagedu jiwu tagaibo tabo. Tadudo tu meture taiwu tagudau areia tabo. Tadudo tu nowu tawure tadawu tabo. Tadukaba ia tagudau tabo pugeje.
Tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje tarudumode boe ji. Etaidumode tai dukeje tagamudo ebo ji nowu tadumode kejewu meri ka.

Mare tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka pugeje mare nowu boe ekimadumodukare tagabo. Etaidumodukare tuwiapagawo tawadaru ji. Dukeje tadudo epiji. Tadumode epiji dukeje tawure okeakejewu to pui egai tawo moto urugudu barigu tawure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu erore jiboe ji kodire umode tugera ra epiji.
Nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eture. Emagore Jesus bataru ji boe ewiagai ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji.
Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere bope doge ewari etawuje boe epiji. Ere boekaguru redo kogodurewuge etaora keje nono Pao Kurirewu ure epemegago rugadu.
João Batista Bitodure

Boe eiamedu boe emearudure nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji. Etaidure tuioruduwawo kakojiwu imedu ba ure ema. Iage egore eliasnure ema. Mare iage egore boro. Elias karega. Ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure ema. Ure nono jaoboe makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge emogadure. Mare ia boe egore boro. João Batistanure ema. Jewodure pugeje! Dukodire rakare tuwo boe pemegado boe ji. Boe eimijera kurirewu Herodes mearudure nowu inoduji jamedu.
Herodes akore João Batistanure ema rugadu. Ire João Batista itoru kado kodire bire. Macare jewodure pugeje. Mare Herodes okware boeto. João Batista bire rugadu.

Marigudu nowu Herodes ure tugeragu tumana Filipe oredujeji tumana piji toredujece. Nou aredu iere Herodias. Herodes ure tugeragu ji tumana piji tumuguwo apo rugadu. Dukodire João Batista mako pegare Herodes rore aino duji. Mako raire ji. Akore arokaba aino amana oredujeji. Paro kigodukare aino. Amearutoru bokware dukodire amugure nowu aredu Herodias apo. Ainore João Batista akore. Herodias korigodure João Batista akoino duji dukodire Herodes makore to tugobaigaregei ewo João Batista kogudo tuwo tugu baicorewuto.

Herodias korigodu kimore João Batistaji dukodire aidure tuwo bito. Mare boe etaidure João Batistaji. João Batista ro pemega kuricigore boe eiamedu boe ji. Dukodire Herodes pagudure turo pegawo João Batistaji dukodire ukare João Batista bito. Herodes aidure tuwiapagawo João Batista bataru ji. Mare biapagare João Batista bataru ji dukeje biagorore rugadu.

Ia meri keje Herodias joruduware nuba turomode tuwo João Batista bito. Herodes ure tuwadae towuje tuwiabutuwo tuwudure kejewu ari keje. Makore boe eimijerage eiamedu boe ewagai Galiléia moto keje. Etaregodure tuwaduwo apo nowu meri ji. Makore tugobaigarege eimijerage ewagai jamedu.

Ere bato pui dukeje Herodias onaregedu rerure nowu boe eiamedu boe egai. Ure Herodes jakaredo pudui. Ure nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe egaredo pudui jamedu. Dukodire Herodes makore nowu nogwareduji. Akore amearutorudo i. Kaba jiba akaidure? Imode akogwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku akai rugadu.

Nono Herodes mako pemegare ji pugeje. Akore imagore jiboe imodukare udo tugirimi. Imode maku. Imode akaidure jiboe maku akai rugadu. Akaidumode ia ino moto ji dukeje imode ino moto kado puiato. Imode maku akai rugadu.
Nono nowu nogwaredu uture epiji tuje bagai. Makore tujeji. Akore kaboba bagaiba inogwamagudumode Herodiji? Uce makore tonaregeduji. Akore akogwamagududo João Batista aora bagai.
Dukodire nowu nogwaredu uture tuibagi tumara tabo Herodes ae. Akore itaidure João Batista aoraji. João Batista aora bu ia baku keje kuri aino rugadu awo aora maku inai.

Herodes mearudure nowu inoduji dukeje kiarigodure rugadu. Aidukare tuwo João Batista bito. Mare makore nowu boe egai tumoduie nowu nogwaredu okwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku ai rugadu. Nou makore bagaiboe makudumoduie ai rugadu. Dukodire Herodes aidukare tuwo tuwadaru pogurudo.

Dukodire makore ia tugobaigare bagai uwo João Batista bito, uwo aora kado piji, uwo João Batista aora reko pudae. Dukodire nowu tugobaigare uture João Batista bagai nowu baicorewu ka tuwo João Batista bito. Ure João Batista itoru kado kodire ure bito.
Dukejere tugobaigare aregodure João Batista aora tabo. Padure baku keje. Nono ca ure maku nowu nogwaredu ai. Dukeje care nowu nogwaredu ure reko toro tuje ae rugadu.
Nono ca João Batista utugarege emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje etaregodure tugimijera birewu bagai. Nono ca ere tugeragu birewuji. Ere reko toro to moto ka tuwo tugu toro to moto keje.
Jesus Ure Boe Eke Maku Boe Etai. Ime Enodo Padure Cinco Mil
Uture Jesus bataru tabowuge ere tugirimi Jesus ae pugeje. Enodo padure doze. Ereadodure turore jiboe ji, tumagore jiboe ji Jesus biagai.

Boe emagare nono. Etaregodure tumagowo Jesus ji. Iage eture mare iage etaregodure pugeje tumagowo Jesus ji jamedu. Dukodire Jesus roiwakare tuwo boe kowuje nowu boe doge eigoia. Nou ure joruduwadowuge enogwagekare jamedu. Dukodire Jesus makore ei. Akore Paduwo ia boe eda tuginaiwu ka awu boe epiji pawo pagamudo.
Dukodire eture ika kurirewu tabo ia boe maerewu ka nowu boe epiji tuwo tamudo.
Mare boe erudure ei rugadu. Dukodire eregodure ika kurirewu me keje taregoduwo nowu ika kurirewu otodai tubagawo ewagai toro. Nou boe emagare toro. Etaregodure boe eda jamedu boe piji.

Jesus aregodure nowu pobo maerewu okwa ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Mare boe emagare nono marigudu. Jesus ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji dukeje jorudure nowu boe ji rugadu. Okudugodure ebo rugadu. Akore eie nono ovelha doge emogadure. Jetu pemegare eiwu bokwaie. Mare ovelha ji karega akoino. Nou boe eroiwakare tuwo tuginorudo. Dujire akoino. Dukodire mako raire ei tuwo eruduwado boe jamedu boe ji.
Merirekodutabo Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure ae. Enodo padure doze. Emagore Jesus ji. egore Merirekodure. Awu boe etudo awu boe maerewu piji. Boe bokware woe du kodi.
Awu boe etudo ia boe etae ewo tugeragu ia tuge roguji.

Mare Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore boro. Taigoiare tamode enogwagedo. egore awu boe emagare. Boe maragodumode kejewu arimode oito dukeje o dieromode tuwo akirodo boe ekeji awu boe ekece. Mare pago diero bokware. Nuba paromode pawo enogwagedo?

Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore Page amirewu rogure? Tagaiwodo bagai. Dukodire Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaiwore amirewu bagai. Erudu iaji dukeje ere reko Jesus ae. egore akaiwodo. Cerudure jiwu amirewu ure ikera aboudure tu je. Page karorogu ere pobetu je.
Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ewo tudo pui ewo tudo cinquenta ewo tudo cem tu tu tumuga boe keje.
Dukodire nowu boe eiamedu boe ere tudo pui. Ere tudo cinquenta ere tudo cem tu tu nowu tumuga boebutu keje.

Nono Jesus ure tugeragu nowu amirewu ji nowu kare kugurei. Nou amirewu ure ikera aboudure. Nou kare kugure ere pobetu je. Nono Jesus aiwore baru to. Dukeje Jesus imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo jamedu. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado tuwo maku nowu ture joruduwadowuge etai ewo pedo nowu boe dogei jamedu. Nono Jesus ure nowu kare ekado jamedu nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewo pedo ei jamedu.
Jesus koiare ure nowu boe doge eke kodudo tugori boe eiamedu boe etai. Boe eiamedu boe enogwagere rugadu. Ekuredure egarere pudui rugadu.
Ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere nowu kadarabo doge korau nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nou kadarabo doge enodo padure doze nowu boe eke kobo tabo rugadu.
Ime enodo padure cinco mil nono togwage tabo nowu meri ji.
Jesus Merure Pobo Aoji

Kuri je dukeje Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei ewo turemo ika kurirewuto etuwo tododai. Ekurugoduwo nowu pobo maerewu kajeje toro bakowu ka toro Betsaida ba kurirewu ka. Jesus rakojere eiageje tumago tabo nowu boe ji tuwo etudo.
Jesus uture nowu boe epiji dukeje Jesus ruture toro ia tori ao ka tuginaigodu tumagowo Pao Kurirewu ji.
Boecodure dukeje nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eture tabowu ika kurirewu mugu kimore nowu pobo maerewu oiadada. Mare Jesus rakoje kimore toro nowu tori aogeje tuginaigodu.

Barogwakododukare raga dutabo Jesus jorudure ture joruduwadowugei toro pobo maerewu oiadada. Bakuru jore etogi. Boe korire nowu bakuruji rugadu dukodire ere tubeodo pudui traiga tabo nowu ikaji nowu bakuru togi. Toro baregodutabo, Jesus uture toro tumeru tabo pobo aoji. Ca ure tugoduiago toro etododai.
Mare nowu ture joruduwadowuge erudure Jesus merure pobo aoji. Emearudaere ia boe pegarewu nuie ema. Dukodire epagudugodure. Nono etokudure tubagudu koia ce.
Eiamedu boe epagudugodure rugadu. Ca Jesus makore ei. Akore taragado tai! Imi rugadu reo. Tabagudukaba.
Nono ure turemo ika kurirewuto ebo. Ca nowu bakuru rakarewu akedure taci je. Nou ure joruduwadowuge erore ta je.

Jesus ure boe enogwagedo jawu meri ji. Boe ekuredure rugadu dukodire egarere pudui. Mare nowu ure joruduwadowuge etaidukare tumearutoruwo ji dukodire eruduwakare Jesus rore jiboe ji. Pao Kurirewu maragodae reno. Ca Jesus merure pobo aoji, ure bakuru rakarewu akedudo jamedu mare nowu ure joruduwadowuge etaidukare tumearutoruwo ji raga dukodire eruduwakare nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji pugeje. Pao Kurirewu maragodae reno pugeje.
Jesus Iogore Boei Genesaré Ba Kurirewu Keje
Ekurugodure nowu pobo maerewu kajeje dukeje etaregodure Genesaré moto ka. Nonore ere to ika kurirewu bu. Ere kogudo.
Ere tudawuje to ika kurirewu piji dukeje boe erudure Jesus ji. Eruduware Jesus ure ema duji.

Dukodire nowu boe eregodure nowu boe eda jamedu boe ji tuwo nowu boe ewie Jesus aregodure duji. Dukodire boe eiamedu boe etaregodure tuwobe kogodurewugebo Jesus ae. Nou kogodurewuge epadure tugudau kodo keje.

Jesus uture nowu boe eiamedu boe eda ka. Uture boe eda ka dukeje boe etaregodure ae kogodurewugebo. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje. Uture ba kurirewu ka dukeje boe etaregodure ae kogodurewugebo nono jamedu. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje jamedu. Nono nowu ure tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa kejewuge eiamedu boe epemegagodure rugadu.
Jesus Makore Nou Judeu Doge Eroiaji
Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jerusalém piji Jesus ae. Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure Jerusalém piji Jesus ae jamedu. Ere bato pui Jesus ae.

Eruduware Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enogwagere tugera tabo duji. Nou fariseu doge etaidure boe ewo tugera kabi nono mariguduwuge tuwobe ero mogadure. Judeu doge erore tu tu aino togwagewo. Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erokare nono ero mogadure.

Marigudu fariseu doge, Judeu doge eiamedu boe erore nowu mariguduwuge tugimijerage ere maku pudaiwu bakaru tadawu ero boe ji tu tu je. Dukodire marigudu ere tugera kabi nono mariguduwuge Judeu doge ero mogadure togwagewo tu tu je. Ainore erore jii aino.

Emode akirodo tugeji nowu boe jeto tadawu bai piji dukeje emode kabi nono mariguduwuge Judeu doge ero mogadure jamedu tu tu je. Mariguduwuge Judeu doge eno bakaru kurire dukodire erore jiboe makare rugadu. Kodire ere turuwobo kabi tu tu je. Ere tudaria kabi tu tu je. Ere tubagaga kabi tu tu je. Ere tubadure kejewu kamorewu kabi tu tu je jamedu. Emodukare tugera ra turore aino dupiji rugadu. Turoia jire eroino tu tu je tuwo nowu jamedu boe pemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu turo boe ji tu tu je.

Dukodire nowu fariseu doge, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaidukare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekare tugera kabi duji. Enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba nowu are joruduwadowuge emearutorukare mariguduwuge pawobe emagore jiboe ji? Erokare nono nowu mariguduwuge pawobe ero mogadure. Enogwagere mare ekare tugera kabi nono nowu mariguduwu paro mogadure. Ukare turugadu.

Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore tare boe eruduwado mare tamearutorukare tawadaru ji. Boe jokodu jire Isaías akoino marigudu. Marigudu rugadu ure pawobe ewie taromode tamearudaemode jiboe ji. Marigudu Isaías akore Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie rugadu. Akore Awu boe emagore togwa tabo tumearutoruie i mare emearudae remawu ure tuginai rugadu toro imearudae piji rugadu.
– “Awu boe ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo i mare pagare egoino. Ere boe eruduwado bakaruji. Egore iwadaruie. Mare pagare egoino. Ia tumagore jiwu bakaru jire nowu boe egoino.”

Jesus makore nowu fariseu dogei pugeje. Akore taro kodure nowu imedu Isaías ure boe ewie jiboe ji rugadu. Tare tagera ra Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu piji tamearutoruwo tu tamearudae ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru ji karega tagagoino.
– Jerorewugenure tagi. Tamago moture tawo boe emearutorudo tawadaru ji ekoduwo nowu tamearudae rekodaji emearutorukawo Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji.

Marigudu Moisés ure pawobe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji. Akore Tamearutorudo taoji tajeji. Ca nowu boe mako pegamode tuoji tujeji tuwo epogurudo dukeje bitoduiago.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore jawu tawobei.

Mare tagi tare boe eruduwado ia bataru tuginaiwuji boe ekawo tugera maku tuo ai tuje ai. Tagagore imedu makomoduie tujeji tuoji tumodukaie tugera maku etai tumoduie toe maku Pao Kurirewu ai kodi. Dukodire tumodukaie tugera maku tuo ai tuje ai. Ainore boe eromoduie.
Mare pagare egoino. Etaidukare tuwo tugera maku tuje ai tuo ai dukodire egoino.

Taigoiare tare boe egodo aino. Dukodire care tagaidukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Tamearutorukare ji. Tagaidure tagoduwo nowu tamearudae rekodaji. Ainore tarore ia taroji jamedu. Tare taro udo tuginai Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu piji rugadu.
Ainore Boe Emode Tubegado
Nono Jesus makore boe makarewuge etae ewo bato pui pudae. Makore nowu boe ji. Akore taiamedu boe tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Iwo taruduwa kuricigodo iwadaru ji.

Nou tagwagemode jiboe umodukare tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumodukare tago bakaru tadawu taro piji. Mare nowu taiabijiwu tawadaru pegarewu umode tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumode tago bakaru tadawu taro piji jii je.
Dukeje Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji uwo tuioruduwado kaba jiba akoino nowu boe ji.
Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore taruduwa bokware nono nowu boe emogadure. Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Tamodukare tabegado tage tabo rugadu.

Tamode tage ko dukeje taguredumode. Nono umode tudawuje tabiji. Mare tabemega kimomode tarowo boe eno bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Tage umodukare tamearudae pegado boe ji. Tagoino dutabo Jesus ure nowu Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu ia ero akedudo. Nou bakaru akore ekaiago ia tuge kowuje tuwo tubemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Aino care Jesus ure nowu bakaru akedudo. Boe eke jamedu boe uie turugadu.
Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore boe ero pegarewu umode tudawuje boe emearudae piji. Nou inodu koiare umode boe epegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.
Du nowu boe emearudae pegarewu aregodumode epiji rugadu. Emode nowu tumearudae tawuje turo pegawo rugadu. Ero pegamode tieribari tabo. Ekiwogumode. Emode boe ewido.

Eribarimode toreduje piji toredu piji. Enogwa kidumode tu pudai tuwo toe kurido tumedage epiji. Emode turo pegarewu kurido rugadu. Boe emode boe ekiripagado. Boe etaora bai baimode tuge kurure pudui dutabo. Boe ekorigodumode boe enoe keje. Boe emago pegamode tumedage eroji. Boe enojaromode tuwadaru ji. Boe eruduwa bokwamode turore jiboe ji.

Boe emode tumearudae pegarewu tawuje turowo awu boe ero pegarewu jamedu boe ji. Awu boe ero pegarewu koiare umode boe epegado rugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.
Aredu Tuginaiwudo

Nono Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Uture toro ia moto ka. Puredure Tiro ba kurirewuji. Nono ure turemo ia boe ewaito. Aidure tuwo tamudo. Aidukare boe eruduwawo turagojere nono duji mare boe erudure ure turemo nowu bai toduji.
Ia aredu joruduware Jesus rakojere nono duji. Bope uwari meture nowu aredu onaregedu tada. Dukodire uce aregodure Jesus ae. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai.
Nou aredu Judeu kejewu aredu karegure ema. Boture Fenícia moto keje puredure Síria moto ji. Okwamagudure Jesus ji uwo nowu bope uwari tawuje tonaregedu aredu piji.
Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore boe etore enogwagewo jii tuguredu ka. Ukare turugadu boe ewo tore ekerogu tawuje epiji tuwo maku tagu ariga doge etai.

Nou aredu joruduware boe etore ji karega Jesus akoino duji. Joruduware Judeu dogeire Jesus akoino duji. Jesus aregodure moto ka tumagowo Judeu dogei rugadu. Nono nowu aredu makore Jesus bataru jipagi. Akore boe rugadu. Mare ariga doge epuredumode boe etorei tuwo nowu buture ira kudawu boe etore eke gigudu rugadu boe kowuje.
Jesus akore Boe jokodu. Atudo aibagi awai ka akanaregedu aredu bagai. Ire nowu bope uwari tawuje piji dukodire akanaregedu pemegagodure rugadu. Nou bope uwari ure tudawuje piji.

Dukodire nowu aredu ure tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka tuioruduwo tonaregeduji. Aregodure tuwai ka dukeje jorudure tonaregedu padure kamorewu keje duji. Pemegagodure. Nou bope uwari ure tudawuje piji rugadu.
Jesus Ure Bija Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago

Nono Jesus uture nowu Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge epiji. Uture Sidom ba kurirewu ka. Dukeje merure boe eda kejewu moto ji. Boe eda enodo padure dez nono nowu moto keje. Nono aregodure nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa ka.
Nonore ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae ia bija bokwarewu imedu apo. Roiwakare tumagowo jamedu. Nono nowu boe enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera bu nowu imedu keje pemegagoduwo.
Dukodire Jesus ure taradaino boe epiji nowu imedu apo. Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu bija keje pudogi. Dukejere ure todoguru bu tugerako keje. Nono ure raido nowu imedu eru ka.
Nono Jesus aiwore baru to. Ure ake tawuje tubiji. Dukejere makore Judeu doge ewadaru tabo. Akore efatá. (Boe ewadaru tabore boe egore: “Uwo tuiado” aino.)
Ca nowu imedu bija pemegagodure pugeje taci je. Mearudure boe emagoji rugadu. Makore jamedu. Mako pemegare.
Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ekawo boe ewie nowu turore jiboe ji. Makore ei mare emearutorukare. Ere boe ewie rugadu.

Biapagare nowu Jesus ro jiwuge eiamedu boe erore ta je. egore awu Jesus ro pemegare rugadu! Rakare rugadu kodire umode bija bokwarewuge ewija epemegago emearuduwo boe ji eruduwawo boe emagore pudui duji. Rakare tuwo mako bokwarewuge emagodo pugeje.
Jesus Ure Ia Boe Makarewuge Enogwagedo Jamedu
Ia meri keje boe ere bato pui pugeje tuwiapagawo Jesus bataru ji. Emagare rugadu. Enodo padure quatro mil. Care eke akedure dukeje Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae. Nono ca makore ei.
Akore inogudugodure awu boebo. Merire pobe metia bokware ei woe itabo. Woe boe eke bokware rugadu ewo ko.
Itaidukare iwo etudo tuguri bioro tabo mare eragamodukare tumeruwo awara ji pugeje. Iage etaregodu jaere woe itae.
Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nou boe emagare rugadu woe pagabo. Nuba ceromode woe boe maerewuto boe eke bagai nowu boe ekeje?
Jesus akore Nuba tage amirewu rogure tu je? egore amirewu oto padure sete.

Nono Jesus makore boe eiamedu boe ji ewo tumugudo moto keje. Dukejere ure tugeragu nowu amirewuji. Nono imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo. Dukejere ure nowu amirewu kado. Ure maku ture joruduwadowuge etai ewo reko boe etae. Dukodire ere pedo boe eiamedu boe ji rugadu.
Ia kare kugurere nono jamedu. Jesus imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo. Dukejere makore ture joruduwadowugei ewo nowu kare kugure pedo boe eiamedu boe ji jamedu.

Nono ca nowu boe eiamedu boe enogwagere. Egarere pudui rugadu tuguredure duji. Emagare. Enodo padure quatro mil. Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere kadarabo korobadurewugedo sete nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ewo tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka pugeje.
Dukejere Jesus ure taredo ika kurirewuto ture joruduwadowugebo. Eture toro Dalmanuta moto ka.
Fariseu Doge Etaidure Tuioruduwo Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewuji

Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jesus ae. Ere tunarado ji tumago rakarewu tabo tuioruduwo joruduwamode rugadu dubagai. Dukodire enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo ia turo ro rakarewu to tiagai tuioruduwo nouia ro rakarewu aregodure rugadu Pao Kurirewu piji du bagai.

Mare Jesus joruduware nowu boe emearutorukare pudui duji dukodire ure ake ta tubiji tugiarigodure dukodi. Nono akore Kocare awu boe etaidure tu iro rakawo tuioruduwawo i rugadu. Boro! Iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji rugadu! Pagare egoino. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo i rugadu.
Dukodire uture epiji. Ure taredo ika kurirewuto pugeje tugurugoduwo nowu pobo maerewu okwa ka.
Fariseu Doge Ero Pegarewu Reo
Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewiagodure tuwo tugeragu ia tuge amirewu ji pugeje. Dukodire eke akedugodure. Eke amirewure mitotu je nowu ika kurirewu tada.

Jesus makore ei. Akore tawiapagado tawo tado tarugadu. Fariseu doge emearudae ure nono fermento mogadure. Herodes mearudae ure nono fermento mogadure jamedu. Tamearudaekaba nono nowu emearudae mogadure.
Dukodire nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui kaba jiba akoino nowu fermento jiboe ji. Egore pui: – Pawiagodure page amirewu piji dukodire Pagimijera akoino pai.
Jesus joruduware egoino pui duji. Nono unaragodure ei. Akore kodiba tamagore pui nowu tage amirewu bokwaie duji? Kocare taruduwa bokware kimo? Tagaora rakare taruduwawo iwadaru ji.
Taekure taruduwo irore jiboe ji. Tawijare tamearuduwo imagore jiboe ji. Mare tawiagodure irore jiboe piji, imagore jiboe piji marigudu.

Ire boe ekerogu kado dukeje nowu boe eke kodure kuri boe ekori. Ire boe enogwagedo nowu boe eke roguji. Nou boe enodo padure cinco mil. Enogwagere dukeje tare boe eke kobo tugu kadaraboto boe etuwo tabo. Nuba tare korau kadarabo ure nowu boe eke kobo tabo? egore oto padure doze.

Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore ca ia meri keje ire boe enogwagedo pugeje. Nou amirewu ure sete. Ire kado boe etai pugeje du nowu ime enodo padure quatro mil. Ca nuba tare korau kadarabo dogere nowu boe eke kobo tabo? egore oto padure sete.
Jesus akore Kocare taruduwa bokware imearudae remawu ji kana?
Jesus Ure Joku Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago
Jesus a regodure ture joruduwadowugebo Betsaida ba kurirewu ka. Nono ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae ia joku bokwarewu imedu apo. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera bu keje.

Jesus ure tugeragu nowu joku bokwarewu imedu ieraji. Uture apo toro nowu ba kurirewu piji tugiogowo nowu imeduji. Nono Jesus ure todoguru bu nowu imedu joku keje. Nono Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu keje jamedu. Dukejere unarare ji. Akore arudure iaboe ji?
Nou imedu aiwore. Dukeje akore Uu. Iorudure ia boe ji. Mare ioruduwakare ei. Ere nono igurure tumeru tabo mato, toro, mato, toro, mato.
Nono Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu joku keje. Dukejere nowu imedu aiwore pugeje. Care joku pemegagodure. Jorudure boe ji rugadu.
Nono Jesus makore ji utuwo tuibagi tuwai ka. Akore akaba akirimi ba kurirewu ka. Atudo jii toro awai ka.
Pedro Akore umode Boe Ekinorudowu Nuie Jesusce Rugadu

Dukejere Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo nowu ba kurirewu piji toro ia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda puredure Cesaréia Filipe ba kurirewuji. Nou awara ji Jesus unarare nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore nuba boe emearudaere i?
egore boe egore João Batista nuie aki. Nouiage egore elias nuie aki. Nouiage egore ia mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu nuie aki.
Nono Jesus unarare ei pugeje. Akore tagi. Nuba tamearudaere i? Pedro akore Umode boe ekinorudowunure aki rugadu.
Nono Jesus akore Tamagokaba awu tamearudaere idu jiboe ji boe ewiagai.
Jesus Ure Ewie Tuwimode Duji

Nono Jesus ure nowu ture joruduwadowuge eruduwado pugeje. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Judeu doge eimijerage erudu pegamode i. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage erudu pegamode i. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge erudu pegamode i. Emode boe pegado i rugadu. Emode iwido. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode pugeje.

Jesus mako pemegare nowu tuwadaru ji nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewiagai eruduwawo boe mode pudui duji. Mare Pedro aidukare nowu Jesus bataru ji. Ure tumegido Jesus apo kuri nono tumagowo ji. Akore boe modukare aino ai.

Mare Jesus ure tumegido. Nono aiwore nowu ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ji. Dukejere mako rakare Pedro ji. Akore akaradai ikoda piji Satanás. Amearudae jire inagoino. Amearudaere nono boe emearudae mogadure. Boe emearudaekare nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure.

Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai ewo tuburedo pudui. Makore ia boe ewagai jamedu. Dukejere makore ei. Akore ia tagi tagaidumode tamearutoruwo i dukeje tagera ra taro pegarewu piji, tawia ra tamearudae pegarewu piji, tagaidure jiboe piji. Tado tarugadu boe pegawo tai nono boe pegamode i dumogadure. Iwimode ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Dukodire inagoino tai tawo tado tarugadu tagoduwo itabo.

Boe ewiapagamode tuwo boe pemegado tu pudui turaga tabo dukeje nowu boe eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Emodukare tuginorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare boe ewiapagamodukare tumearudae ji pugeje tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji tumearudae pegarewu piji tuwo tumagu inai tuwo boe eruduwado iwu bakaru pemegarewu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu.

Imedu umode toedo boe jamedu boece. Mare nowu oe umodukare imedu rutudo baru to. Ca nowu imedu biagorokare tuwo tumearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Biagorore tu tuwo toe kurido pagatu je. Mare paga karega inagoino. Boe emodukare turudu morido toe tabo.

Ro pegarewuge emagare rugadu. Ro pegarewuge tieribari tabowuge emagare rugadu. Mare ia boe epogurure tumagowo iwu bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai dukeje imodukare ikeragu ei itae. Itaregodumode Pao Kurirewu o jorugu pemegarewu tabo Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawugebo dukeje imodukare ikeragu ei. Nou Pao Kurirewu o jorugu pemegarewu urugure Pao Kurirewu kujegajeje. Imode ikirimi mato dukeje urugumode nowu aregodumode itabowu Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ekujegajeje jamedu.

Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowugei pugeje. Akore iwo tawie. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje aregodumode turaga tabo rugadu. Ia tagi tarudumode awu inagoino jiboe ji. Tawimodukare jii toro tarudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu roino jitu ka.
Jesus Ure Tiedo Tuginai

Meri oto padure seis Jesus ji pugeje. Nono ca uture Pedro apo, Tiago apo, João apo toro ia tori ricorewu ao ka. Tu emagere edure nono nowu tori aogeje. Nono nowu Jesus je ure tudo tuginai. Nou ure joruduwadowuge erudure ji rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu koiare ure Jesus je udo tuginai.
Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus ukudau areia kigadu maerewudo ji. Kigadure rugadu kigadureboe jamedu boe kori.
Nono ca rore puku ei ime edure nono ebo. Eliare Moisere edu nono tumago tabo Jesus ji.
Nono Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore ikimijera. Ure turugadu paeduwo woe. Cemode ia macebradudo pobe metia bokware. Iamode akai. Iamode Moisés ai. Iamode Elias ai jamedu.
Pedro, Tiago, João epagudugodure dukodire Pedro makore aino. Dukodire eruduwakare tumagomode jiboe ji.

Nono ia boetugu ure turawuje etae. Nou boetugu ure taiado ebo. Nono emearudure ia boe emagoji nowu boetugu piji. Akore imearudu kurire jiwu itonaregedu reo. Tawiapaga pemegado awu itonaregedu bataru ji.
Nono ere tie maedo mare erudukare ia boe ji pugeje. Tu emagere eragojere nono Jesus apo.

Nono ere turawuje nowu tori ao piji. Dukejere Jesus makore ei. Akore tareadodukaba tarudure jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Iewodumode pugeje dukeje tareadodumode awu tarudure jiboe ji boe ewiagai.
Emearutorure awu Jesus bataru ji. Mare puire enarare. egore nuburedu jiba akoino pai tuiewodumoduie pugeje?
Dukodire enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba pawobe eruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge egore elias aregodumoduie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu otodai?

Jesus akore Pao Kurirewu makore boe ji marigudu Elias aregodumoduie boeto ji rugadu. Umoduie boe ewie ewo tudo turugadu nowu umode boe ekinorudowu aregoduwo etae rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu bataru makore boe ji marigudu boe pegamoduie nowu Imedu Onaregeduji. Boe etaidumodukaie nowu Imedu Onaregeduji.

Mare inure tawie. Nou Pao Kurirewu makore jiwu imedu Elias aregodure marigudu. João Batistare ema. Rore nono Elias ro mogadure. Mare boe etaidukare ji. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu ainoie boemoduie nowu Eliaji. Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu João Batistaji.
Jesus Ure Mareboe Meture Tadawu Iparedu Pemegago

Nono Jesus aregodure nouia ture joruduwadowuge etae Pedro apo, João apo, Tiago apo. Boe emagare nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowugebo. Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge edure nono ebo jamedu. Etokire pui.
Boe erudure Jesus ji dukeje egarere pudui. Nono eregodure togi. Ekimadure Jesus apo.
Mare Jesus unarare ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore kaba tawadaru jiba tagagoino nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugei?

Nono ia imedu rakojere boe etoiadada. Makore Jesus ji. Akore ikimijera. Itaregodure itonaregedu apo woe are joruduwadowuge etae. Bope uwari meture awu itonaregedu tada. Dukodire itonaregedu roiwakare tumagowo.

Nou bope uwari ro pegare itonaregeduji. Ure butudo moto ka. Nou itonaregedu jataro aregodure jabiji. Ure tora reko pui. Nono rakagodure. Inogwamagudure are joruduwadowugei ewo nowu bope uwari pegarewu barigu piji mare ero cekare ji.
Jesus makore ei. Akore tare ikiarigo. Tamearutorukare rugadu. Iragoje raimodukare tagabo. Nuba tagaidure irowo tamearutoruwo i? Nono Jesus makore iagei. Akore mato nowu iparedu apo itae!

Dukodire boe ere nowu iparedu reko Jesus ae. Nou meture nowu iparedu tadawu bope uwari jorudure Jesus ji dukeje ure nowu iparedu butudo moto ka pugeje. Magadugodure moto keje. Nou iparedu jataro aregodure ja piji. Dukodire Jesus makore nowu iparedu uoji jamedu.
Akore marigudu na nowu bope roino akanaregeduji? Nou iparedu uo akore Marigudu rugadu. Imedurogu biagare tu je dutabore nowu bope uwari roino ji jii aino.
Mai karega roino ji. Ure barigu joru to biwo joru tada. Dukeje ure barigu poboto biwo pobo tada. Inogwamagudunure ai. Akogududo cedabo. Aroiware dukeje awu itonaregedu pemegago.
Jesus akore Uu. Mare amearutorumode rugadu dukeje aroiwamode boe jamedu boe ji.
Nou imedu aidure rugadu. Akore imearutorure ai. Imearudae pegarewu tawuje ipiji imearutoru raiwo ai rugadu.

Jesus jorudure nowu boe emagare turegodu tabo mato pudae duji. Nono mako pegare nowu meture nowu iparedu tadawu bope uwariji. Akore bope uwarinure aki. Mako bokwarewunure aki. Bija bokwarewunure aki. Atudo awu iparedu piji. Amodukare aremo to pugeje!
Nou bope uwari kudugodure. Nono ure nowu iparedu butudo moto ka pugeje. Mare ure tudawuje nowu iparedu piji rugadu. Nono nowu iparedu ure nono birewuboe mogadure. Nou boe egore bire rugadu!
Mare Jesus ure tugeragu nowu iparedu ieraji. Dukejere ure udo turagojedo pugeje.
Nono Jesus ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba ceroiwakare cewo nowu bope uwari tawuje nowu iparedu piji?

Jesus akore Boe emagomodukare baru to dukeje eroiwamodukare tuwo awu bope uwari tawuje boe epiji. Boe enogwamaguduwo baru to nono boe eroiwamode tuwo bope uwari tawuje piji. Ia boe eroiwamodukare tuwo tawuje rugadu.
Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Tuwimoduie Tuiewodumoduie Pugeje Jamedu
Jesus uture nowu moto piji ture joruduwadowugebo jii toro nowu Galiléia moto ka.

Jesus mearudaere tuwo tudaru kuri boe poru ka jao ture joruduwadowugebo tuwo eruduwado nuba boemode pudui duji. Makore ei. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imagudumode ro pegarewuge etai. Emode iwido. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware i dukejere iewodumode pugeje.
Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eruduwakare nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji. Mare epagudure tunarawo Jesus ji kaba jiba Jesus akoino pudui.
Duboba Boe Eimijerage Mode Emage
Jesus aregodure Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Ere turemo ia baito dukeje Jesus unarare ei. Akore tagokire pui awara ji. Kaboba bagaiba tagagoino pui?

Mare emagokare Jesus bataru jipagi. Eiamedu boe etaidure tuwo boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi tumedage epiji. Dukodire etokire pui awara ji. Nono epogurure tumagowo tumearudae boe ji Jesus biagai. Dukodire emagokare Jesus bataru jipagi.

Nono Jesus ure tumugudo nowu bai tada tumagowo nowu ture joruduwadowugei mare joruduware emearudae boe ji rugadu. Makore ei. Akore boe eimijera mearudaemode nono boe utugare mearudae mogadure tuwo boe eimijera pemegarewudo pudumi. Boe eimijera romode nono boe utugare ro mogadure tuwo boe eimijera ro pemegarewudo pudumi.
Nono Jesus ure tugeragu ia boe etonaregedu roguji. Makore ji rakojewo nono boe etoiadada. Nono ukimadure apo dukeje makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei pugeje.
Akore boe emode tugera podo boe etonaregedu apo inai itabore ere tugera podo. Boe emode tugera podo itabo ure itarego matowu apore ure tugera podo jamedu.
Ro Pegakare Ceiwuge Etaidure Cei
João makore Jesus ji. Akore cerudure ia imeduji. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji akie tabo. Cemagore ji uwo tugera ra nowu turo piji. Ia are joruduwadowu karegure ema.
Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore Piji. Umode bope tawuje boe epiji ikie tabo dukeje mako pegamodukare i.
Ro pegakare paiwuge emearudu kurinure pai.
Inure tawie. Ia boe eruduware tamearutorure i duji. Nono emode pobo maku tagai taguduwo ce dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei rugadu eroino du morice.
Boe Etaidure Tuwo Boe Ekiripagado Ero Pegawo

Jesus akore Boe emode tori kurirewu kogudo ia boe ekidoru kajeje tuwo ewarigu poboto dukodire nowu ewarigudure pobo towuge ewimode. Mare ia boe umode nowu itore mearutorure maibari iwuge edo tugera ra ipiji ero pegawo pugeje dukeje boe pegamode nowu ure nowu boe etore etaora pegadowuji rugadu. Jire boe pegarewu kodumode nowu barigudure pobo towuge ekori.

Boe etaidukare tugera kadoduwo tugana piji. Mare tagera umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje tagera kado tabiji. Mare tagera remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino tawo barigu tabiji. Mare paga karega. Tamearutorumodukare i dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Nou joru akedumodukare rugadu. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu jii toro rugadu. Mare tamearutorumode i dukeje imode tarududo baru to. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pemegamode tai nono jii toro rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tagera umode mitotu je mare du inodu tabo tamearutorure i dukeje tarudumode baru to rugadu tawikawo pugeje.

Boe etaidukare tuwure kadoduwo tubogora piji. Mare tawure umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje tawure kado tabogora piji. Mare tawure remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino tawo barigu tabiji. Mare paga karega. Tamearutorumodukare i dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu jii toro rugadu. Mare tamearutorumode i dukeje imode tarududo baru to. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pemegamode tai nono jii toro rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tawure umode mitotu je mare du inodu tabo tamearutorure i dukeje tarudumode baru to rugadu tawikawo pugeje.

Boe etaidukare tuioku bokwawo. Mare taeku umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje taeku tawuje tabiji. Mare taeku remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino tawo barigu tabiji. Mare paga karega. Tamodukare tagimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu. Toro ate doge enogwagemode boe ji jii toro. Etagedumodukare. Toro joru umode boe ekowu jii toro. Nou joru akedumodukare jii toro rugadu. Mare tamode tamearudae pegarewu barigu tagaora piji tawo tagimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukeje boe pemegamode tai rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Taeku umode mitotu je mare tamearutorure i rugadu dukeje tarudumode baru to rugadu tawikawo pugeje.
– Joru butumode boe eiamedu boe ewugeje. Nou joru umode boe pegarewu kowu. Nou boe pemegarewu jetumode.

– Sal pemegare. Mare sal pegomode dukeje nowu sal akedumode. Nono umodukare nono sal mogadure pugeje. Sal umode boe eke pemegado. Tarodo pui nono sal mogadure. Mare sal ji karega inagoino. Tagogududo tagabo. Taro pemegado pui tabemegawo pui rugadu.
Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Ekawo Tugera Ra Toreduje Epiji
Nono Jesus uture nowu moto piji toro Judéia moto ka. Kurugodure Jordão po kajeje. Boe emagare taregodutabo Jesus ae pugeje. Dukodire Jesus ure eruduwado nono turo mogadure.

Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jesus ae jamedu. Etaidure tuwo turokogado Jesus ji tuioruduwo ia Jesus ro pegarewu ji ia Jesus mako pegarewuji. Erudumode dukeje emago pegamode ji rugadu. Dukodire enarare Jesus ji. egore nuba Pao Kurirewu ure maku Moisés aiwu pago bakaru akore? Ukana turugadu imedu uwo toreduje utudo tubiji tumugukawo apo pugeje?
Jesus makore ei. Akore nuba nowu mariguduwu Moisés ure maku pagaiwu bakaru akore?

Nou fariseu doge egore Moisés makore mariguduwuge pawobei. Nou bakaru akore imedu aiduie tuwo tugera ra toreduje piji dukeje uwo ia bapera atugodo tuwo toreduje bie kaba kodiba tuie tugera ra toreduje piji rugadu. Imedu romoduie aino du pegakaie. Uwo toreduje utudo tubiji rugadu. Ainore nowu joruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu akore pawobei marigudu.

Jesus akore Uu. Nou mariguduwuge pawobe etaora rakare dukodire etaidukare tuioruduwawo, etaidukare turo pemegawo. Dukodire Moisés ure nowu paro maku mariguduwuge pawobe etai ewo tugera ra toreduje piji.
Mare ukare aino boeto ji. Pao Kurirewu ure baru to. Ure moto to. Dukejere ure imedu boeto jiwu towuje. Ure aredu boeto jiwudo towuje oredujece. Ainore Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera kejewure.
Dukodire imedu utumoduie tuo piji tuje piji tumuguwo toreduje apo dukeje emodukaie pobe pugeje, emoduie mitotu je rugadu.
Dukodire imedu mugumode aredu apo dukeje ere mitotu puapo turoi pui dutabo Pao Kurirewu jakai. Ainore Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera kejewure.
Ca Pao Kurirewu aidure emugure puapo duji. Dukodire emuguwo puapo jii toro rugadu. Ekawo tugera ra pubiji rugadu.
Nono Jesus uture ia bai ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Ere turemo dukeje nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji nowu Jesus bataru bagai.

Jesus makore ei. Akore imedu umode tugera ra toreduje piji mare mugumode ia aredu apo pugeje. Du pegare Pao Kurirewu jakai. Nou imedu ro peganure nowu toreduje boeto jiwudoji rugadu. Ure tudo nono jeribarire toreduje pijiwu mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai.
Aredu jamedu umode tugera ra toredu piji mare mugumode ia imedu apo pugeje. Dutabore ro peganure nowu toredu boeto jiwuji rugadu. Ure tudo nono jeribarire toredu pijiwudo mogadure Pao Kurirewu jakai.
Jesus Ure Tuwadaru Pemegarewu Bu Boe Etore Ewugeje
Ia boe etaregodure torebo Jesus ae Jesus uwo tugera bu nowu boe etore ewugeje. Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaidukare eroino duji. Emagore nowu boe ji etaregodukaiago torebo Jesus bagai.

Jesus joruduware nowu inoduji dukodire korigodure nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tagaba tawu boe etore ekajeje etaregoduwo itae. Etarego itae rugadu. Boe ewo tumearudae udo nono boe etore emearudae mogadure tuwo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce rugadu turuduwo baru to.

Boe jokodu jire inagoino tai. Boe etore emearutorure tuo tuje makore jiboe ji. Mare boe etore ji karega inagoino. Boe ewo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dujire inagoino. Boe emearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje emugumode Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu. Mare emearutorumodukare Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje emugumodukare Pao Kurirewu apo pugeje.
Nono Jesus ure tona bu nowu boe etore ekajeje. Nono ure tugera bu ewugeje. Ure tuwadaru pemegarewu bu ewugeje jamedu.
Imedu Oe Kurire

Nono Jesus uture nowu boe epiji pugeje. Merure awara ji dukeje ia imedu rekodure Jesus rekodaji aidure tumagowo ji kodi. Aregodure Jesus ae dukeje ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus bure paru. Makore Jesus ji. Akore joruduwarewu pemegarewunure aki. Nuba iromode iewoduwo pugeje imuguwo baru tada Pao Kurirewu apo du akedukawo?
Jesus akore Ca akagore pemegarewu nuie imi. Mare tu Pao Kurirewure pemegare tu rugadu. Aruduwa kana Pao Kurirewu nuie imi rugadu? Aino care amearudae pemegado amearutoruwo i rugadu.

Marigudu aruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaruji. Ure maku etai marigudu. Pao Kurirewu akore akaba boe ewido. Aeribarikaba akoreduje piji akoredu piji. Akiwogukaba. Awadrarodukaba boe erore jiboe ji. Akaba boe ekiripagado jamedu. Amearutorudo aoji aceji jamedu.”
Nou imedu akore Uu. Iparedurogu ure imi dutabore imearutorure awu bataru jamedu boe ji ji aino.

Jesus aiwore tu nowu imeduji. Mearudu kurire nowu imeduji. Nono makore ji. Akore iaboe kimore arowo ji. Akoe jamedu boe maku diero bagai. Nou ako diero rugadu maku marenarue doge etai. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode akoe kurido baru tada. Aromode aino dukeje akaregodumode itae pugeje akoduwo itabo.
Nou imedu mearudure Jesus bataru ji dukeje kiarigodure. Oe kurire dukodire aidukare tuwo toe maku. Je kiarigodure. Kodire uture Jesus piji. Mearutorukare Jesus bataru ji.

Jesus aiwore tumebiji ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Makore ei. Akore kocare. Boe rakare oe kurirewugei etaiduwo tuwo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce tumuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada. Oe kurirewuge etaidure tumearutoruwo tu toeji tuwo cinorudo.
Nou ure joruduwadowuge erore ta je nowu Jesus bataru keje. Mare Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore itorenure tagi. Boe rakare oe kurirewugei etaiduwo tuwo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce rugadu.
Boe rakare oe kurirewu imeduji uwo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce tumuguwo apo nono boe rakare cameloji uwo turemo agulha poroto dumogadure.
