Nono Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erore ta je. Egore pui: – Kocare. Ioguduba umode cinorudo tuiewoduwo pugeje tumuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo?
Jesus aiwore tu ei. Dukeje akore Boe eroiwakare tuwo cinorudo rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu roiware tuwo boe ekinorudo rugadu. Pao Kurirewu rakare tuwo boe jamedu boe pemegado boe ji.
Nono Pedro akore akaiwodo. Cere cegera ra cenoe jamedu boe piji cegoduwo akabo.

Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore uu. Mare iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Boe emode tugera ra tuwai piji, tuo piji, tuje piji, tumanamage epiji, tuwiemage epiji, to boepa piji tugoduwo itabo tuwo boe ewie iwadaru pemegarewu ji dukeje boe rugadu boe makudumode etai awu moto keje. Ewai kurimode. Etumana mage emagamode. Etuwie mage emagamode. Etuje mage emagamode. Etore emagamode. Eno boepa kurimode. Mare ro pegarewuge ero pegamode ei pugeje. Mare ia meri keje eewodumode pugeje emuguwo baru tada jii toro rugadu. Ewimodukare pugeje rugadu.

Boe emearudae pemegare oe kurirewugei dukeje egore boe eimijerage nuie emage mare emearutorumodukare Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje marenarue doge mode emage. Iage enoe bokware dukodire boe emearudae pegare ei mare emearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje oe kurirewuge mode emage toro ia meri keje.
Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Pugeje Tuwimoduie

Jesus uture Jerusalém kawu awara ji ture joruduwadowugebo tuduwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Enodo padure doze. Jesus kodure etododai. Nou ure joruduwadowuge epagudure Jerusalém tadawu boe eimijeragece. Ia boe ekodure eregodaji jamedu. Nou kodure eregodajiwuge epagudure nowu boe eimijeragece jamedu. Dukodire Jesus ure tuwuredo. Makore tu nowu ture joruduwadowugei nuba boemode pudui duji.

Akore tawiapagado iwadaru ji. Padumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imagudumode nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etai. Imagudumode nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge eimijerage etai. Nou boe eimijerage egomode ipegaie. Etaidumode tuwo iwido rugadu. Dukodire emode imagu boe tuginaiwuge ekimijerage etai.
Nou boe ekadakagirimode i. Emode todoguru to i. Emode boeto i bukigu tabo. Emode iwido. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware i dukeje iewodumode pugeje.
Tiago, João Enogwamagudumode Jesus ji Uwo Tumearudae Towuje
Nono Zebedeu ore ime emagore Jesus ji. Ia iere Tiago. Uwie iere João. Emagore Jesus ji. egore cegimijera kurirewunure aki. Cedaidure awo iaboe towuje cenai.
Jesus akore Nuba tagaidure irowo tai?

egore boe ekimijera kurirewu mode aki dukeje boe pemegamode ai rugadu. Amugumode ira kurirewu keje nono boe ekimijerage ero mogadure. Dukejere cedaidure cewo cemugudo amegi boe eimijera mugure kejewu ira keje jamedu. Ia cegi cedaidure cemuguwo ira keje akana pemegarewu jagwai. Ia cedaidure cemuguwo akana pegarewu jagwai jamedu.
Jesus makore ei. Akore taruduwakare kaba bagaiba tagagoino. Boe pegamode tai nono boe pegamode i dumogadure dukeje taroiwakana tawo taragado tai tagawo tagera ra tamearutorure idu piji kana?
egore uu. Cemode ceragado cei. Jesus akore Inure tawie. Boe pegamode tai rugadu nono boe pegamode i dumogadure.

Mare iroiwakare iwo tamugudo itabo ikana pemegarewu jagwai, ikana pegarewu jagwai. Pao Kurirewu emare ure nowu imegiwu pemegado. Tu ema joruduware turomode jiboe ji. Emare umode taidure jiwuge emugudo ikana pemegarewu jagwai, ikana pegarewu jagwai.
Nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure dez. Emearudure nowu Tiago nowu João enogwamagudure jiboe ji dukeje ekorigodure nowu tumedage pobedu dogei.

Dukodire Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ewagai. Enodo padure doze. Jesus makore ei. Akore taruduware boe tuginaiwuge eimijerage erore jiboe ji. Ero rakare boe ji. Boe emearutorure tugimijeragei rugadu. Emearutorumodukare ei dukeje nowu boe ekimijerage emode boe pegado nowu mearutorukare puduiwugei rugadu.

Ca tarokaba nono nowu boe eimijera kurirewuge ero mogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe eimijerado tagi dukeje tamearudae udo nono boe utugare mearudae mogadure tawo boe eimijera pemegarewugedo tagi. Boe eimijera romode nono boe utugare ro mogadure tuwo boe eimijera pemegarewudo pudumi.
Ainore irore rugadu. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Mare itaregodukare iwo boe ekimijerado imi. Itaregodure iwo boe etugaredo imi. Itaregodure iwo imagu boe etai. Itaregodure iwiwo boe ero pegarewu morice.
Jesus Umode Joku Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago

Etaregodure Jericó ba kurirewu ka. Nono Jesus uture nowu ba kurirewu piji ture joruduwadowugebo. Ia boe ekodure awara ji Jesus apo jamedu. Emagare rugadu. Nono ia imedu joku bokwarewu mugure nowu awara okwai. Iere Bartimeu. Timeu onaregedunure ema. Okwamagudure boe ji nono tugerogu bagai meri jamedu boe ji.

Mearudure Jesus kodure tugori duji. Dukodire kudugodure Jesus rekodaji. Akore Jesus! Davi Onaregedunure aki! Akogududo itabo! Nou joku bokwarewu imedu joruduware Davi uwobenure Jesus ce duji kodire akoino Davi Onaregedunure ema.
Boe emagare nono apo. Emago pegare ji mugu kiorowo. Mare kudugodu rakare pugeje. Akore davi Onaregedunure aki! Akogududo itabo marenarunure imi!
Jesus ure tuwuredo. Akore mato apo itae. Nono nowu boe emagore nowu joku bokwarewu imeduji. egore ca. Akiarigodukaba pugeje. Jesus makore awagai. Aragojedo.
Dukodire ure tugudau areia biaku epa barigu tubiji tuwo tugera jodo mototo tuwo turagojedo. Uture Jesus ae.
Jesus makore ji. Akore kaba jiba akaidure irowo ai? Nou joku bokwarewu imedu akore Ikimijeranure aki. Itaidure itaiwowo pugeje.

Jesus akore Ca. Amearutorure i dukodire ire apemegago akaiwowo pugeje. Atudo aibagi awai ka. Jesus makore dukeje nowu imedu aiwore pugeje taci je. Aiwore pugeje rugadu. Nono kodure Jesus rekodaji nowu awara ji.
Boe Egaremode Jesus Aregodure Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Ka Duji

Jesus ure taregoduiago Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Epuredugodure boe eda Betfagé ka. Epuredugodure boe eda Betânia ka jamedu. Nou boe eda Betfagé, nowu boe eda Betânia eragoje puredure Oliveira Riji. Dukejere Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ime pobedu dogei tuwo etudo tododai.

Jesus makore ei. Akore tadudo toro nowu boe eda ka. Tagaregodumode toro dukeje tarudumode ia jumenta onaregeduji. Boe ere kogudo nono duji. Nou jumenta rakojere nono mare ia boe ekare tumugudo keje ji aino. Tamode bukigu kiwuje dukeje tadumode mato apo itae.
Ia boe enaramode tai kaba kodiba taroino apo. Tamagodo ei Boe Eimijera aiduie ji. Tumoduie reko tuibagi kuri je.
Dukodire nowu ime pobedu doge eture nowu boe eda ka. Erudure nowu jumenta onaregeduji nono Jesus bataru mogadure. Kogure ia bai poro keje. Ere nowu bukigu kiwuje dukeje ia boe enarare ei.
egore Mure kodiba tamode tageragu nowu jumenta onaregeduji?
Nou ime pobedu doge emagore nowu Jesus makore puduiboe tabore emagore nowu boe ewadaru jipagi. Dukodire nowu boe emago pegakare etuwo apo.
Etaregodure Jesus ae nowu jumenta onaregedu apo dukeje ere padure tuwugejewu tugudau areia boe bu nowu jumenta onaregedu poru keje. Nono Jesus ure tumugudo nowu jumenta keje.
Boe emagare nono. Ere padure tuwugejewu areia boe bu nowu Jesus kodure jiwu awara ji. Ia boe ere bai kado. Ere nowu bai bu awara keje jamedu.

Boe emagare rugadu tugodu tabo Jesus apo. Eture tiegarere pudui dutabo rugadu. Dukodire ewadodu rakare Pao Kurirewu ie tabo. egore Pao Kurirewu pemegare! Pagimijera reo! Pamearutoruwo ji nono mariguduwuge pao mage emearutorure tugimijera kurirewu Davi jitu mogadure. Pao Kurirewu ure arego mato pagae. Uwo boe pemegado ji rugadu! Boe eiamedu boe emago pemegawo ji rugadu moto keje, baru tada jamedu.

Jesus aregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka dukeje uture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka. Ure turemo dukeje aiwore boe parugajeje boe jamedu boe ji. Mare merirekodure dukodire uture pugeje. Uture Betânia ba kurirewu ka tuibagi pugeje ture joruduwadowugebo. Enodo padure doze.
Jesus Mako Pegare Ia Figo Iji
Nou barogwato Jesus utuiago tuibagi boe eda Betânia piji ture joruduwadowugebo. Mare Jesus uke boeire ji.
Jesus aiwo jaere dukeje jorudure ia figo iji. Nou figo i arure rugadu. Dukodire uture ka taiwowo tudu kurodurewu bagai. Mare jorudukare boe ji. Jorudure tu nowu aruji. Nou i tudumodukare nowu ariji.
Nono Jesus mako pegare nowu figo iji. Akore boe emodukare akurodu kowuje pugeje awimode kodi. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emearudure nowu Jesus akoe nowu figo i jituji.
Jesus Ure Turemo Pao Kurirewu Uwaito

Etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka pugeje. Jesus uture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka. Ure turemo nono. Jorudure nowu boe ji ere tagu ie metugoe emagu diero bagai duji, ere diero maku puai duji. Dukodire korigodure. Ure nowu boe enoe rugadu barigu. Ure emugure kejewu ira rugadu boe barigu. Ure nowu metugoe meture tadaboe rugadu barigu. Ure nowu boe etudo Pao Kurirewu uwai piji rugadu.
Makore boe eiamedu boe ji etaregodukawo toe tabo pugeje Pao Kurirewu uwai ka.

Nono makore boe ji tuwo eruduwado. Akore moto rugadu boe kejewuge etaregoduwo awu Pao Kurirewu uwai ka tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to. Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore. Ainore bapera atugo ure. Mare tare awu Pao Kurirewu uwai udo nono iwogurewuge ewai mogadure.

Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emearudure nowu inoduji. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emearudure nowu inoduji jamedu. Dukejere eiamedu boe ekorigodure Jesus ji. Etaiwore ia tumearudae bagai tuwo Jesus bito. Mare boe doge etaidure Jesus ji. Egaregodure pudui Jesus rore jiboe ji, makore jiboe ji. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage epagudure turo pegamode Jesus jituji tumode nowu boe doge ekorigo pudui dukodi.
Merirekodutabo Jesus uture Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji ture joruduwadowugebo.
Erudumode Nou Figo Iji Pugeje
Nou barogwato ca je Jesus merure awara ji pugeje ture joruduwadowugebo. Nono erudure nowu figo iji pugeje. Ma kocare nowu figo i bire rugadu.
Nono Pedro biabuture Jesus makore jiboe keje. Dukodire makore Jesus ji. Akore akaiwodo. Awu amago pegare jiwu figo i bire rugadu.
Jesus akore Tamearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji.

Boe jokodu jire inagoino tai. Tamororamagadukaba. Tamearutorudo rugadu. Tamearutorumode dukeje tamagomode nowu tori riji uwo tuwarigu pobo maerewuto. Tamagomode ji dukeje barigudumode pobo maerewuto rugadu. Mare tamearutorumodukare dukeje umodukare tuwarigu.
Dukodire tamagomode Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to iaboe bagai, tamearutorumode makudumode tagai duji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode tamagore bagaiboe maku tagai rugadu.
Tamagomode baru to dukeje tawiagodudo boe ero pegare taidu piji. Dukodire baru tadare Pao Kurirewu biagodumode taro pegare jiboe piji jamedu.
Boe Enarare Jesus ji Ioguduba Ure Turaga Maku Ai

Jesus aregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka pugeje ture joruduwadowugebo. Jesus merure Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewu oiagi. Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge, nouia Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe etaregodure Jesus ae jamedu.
Eiamedu boe emagore Jesus ji. egore ioguduba ure turaga maku akai aro rakawo aino?
Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore inaramode tai iaboe ji jamedu. Tamagomode iwadaru jipagi dukeje imagomode tawadaru jipagi.
Ca ioguduba ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo? Pao Kurirewu koia kana? Ia boe eigoia kana? Nuba tamearudaere? Tamagodo.

Mare nowu boe eimijerage eruduwakare tumagowo Jesus bataru jipagi. Dukodire emagore pui nuba tagomode Jesus bataru jipagi. egore Pamagomode Pao Kurirewu koiaie ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo mare pamearutorukare nowu inoduji. Awu Jesus joruduware pamearutorukare nowu inodu jituji. Dukodire pagagomode aino dukeje Jesus umode pawadaru pogurudo. Akomode: “Kodiba tamearutorukare ji?” Ainore akomode pai.

Mare pagagomodukare boe eigoiaie. Boe eiamedu boe emearutorure João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jituji. Egore Pao Kurirewu koiare ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage epagudure tumago pegawo João Batista rore jiboe ji tumode boe ekorigo pudui dukodi.

Nono nowu boe eimijerage emagore Jesus ji. egore ceruduwakare ioguduba koiare ure João Batista udo boe etao pegodo. Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore ca tamagokare iwadaru jipagi dukodire imagomodukare ioguduba ure itarego mato jamedu.
Ro Pegarewuge Etu Pemegawo Boepaji

Jesus readodure ia bakaruji boe ewiagai tuwo ewie Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu ji. Akore marigudu ia imedu ure uva tugu to boepa tada. Ure ramiku aiado to boepa tabo. Ure ia moto porodo tuwo tuwuredo nowu uva kurodu keje tuwo kuru tawuje. Ure ia tugamo pemegado boe ewo tumugudo toro aogeje taiwo pemegawo boepaji. Nono ure tugeragu ia boe ji tuwo etudo nowu to boepaji emaragoduwo ji. Nono nowu ore boepa cewu uture epiji tugiriadu tabo toro ia boe eda jaerewu ka.

Nou boepa tadawu uva kurodumode kejewu ari puredugodure dukeje nowu ore boepa cewu ure tudugare utudo toro nowu jeture to boepa jiwuge boe etae nowu tugiriadure kawu moto piji. Ure nowu tudugare utudo uwo tugeragu nowu makudumode pudaiwu boe ji. Nou jeture nowu boepa jiwuge emode uva rugadu kado dukeje emode ia kado puiato nowu ore boepa cewu imedu ai.

Ca nowu utugare aregodure nowu boepa ka. Mare nowu jeture boepa jiwuge etaidukare tuwo uva kado puiato pugeje nowu ore boepa cewu imedu ai. Dukodire ere tugeragu nowu ore boepa cewu utugareji. Ere boeto ji. Dukeje ere utudo tuibagi tugimijera ae tugera kedo tabo.

Nono nowu ore boepa cewu ure ia tudugare utudo etae pugeje. Mare nowu jeture boepa jiwuge ere boeto nowu utugareji pugeje. Ere boeto aoraji. Ero pegare ji rugadu. Ere utudo tuibagi tugera kedo tabo pugeje.

Nono nowu ore boepa cewu ure ia tudugare utudo etae pugeje. Mare ere nowu utugare bito. Nou ore boepa cewu ure tudugarege emagado toro etae rugadu. Mare nowu jeture boepa jiwuge ero pegare nowu ore boepa cewu utugarege eiamedu boe ji. Ere boeto ei. Ere iage ewido.

Nono nowu ore boepa cewu onaregedu imedu ure mitotu je. Mearudu kurire nowu tonaregeduji rugadu. Care ure nowu tonaregedu utudo toro nowu jeture boepa jiwuge ewagai aino boigodu. Nou ore boepa cewu akore Emearutorumode itonaregeduji rugadu.”
– Mare nowu jeture boepa jiwuge emagore pui. Egore: “Awu ore boepa cewu onaregedu reo. Emare omode tuo oe jamedu boece. Pawo bito pagowo awu uo o motoce.”
– Dukodire nowu jeture boepa jiwuge ere tugeragu nowu ore boepa cewu onaregeduji. Ere bito. Ere barigu toro nowu boepa piji.

Jesus mako kimore nowu boe ji. Akore ainore erore rugadu. Ca. Nuba nowu ore boepa cewu romode nowu jeture boepa jiwugei? Aregodumode etae. Umode ewido. Nono umode to boepa maku iage etai etuwo ji pugeje.

Mare tagaiwokare rugadu ia padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji kana? Ainore awu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore Boe emearudae pegare ia toriji. Egore pegaie tuwo tuwaido ema. Mare nowu tori pemegarewunure ema rugadu boe ewo tuwaido ema rugadu.
– Pao Kurirewu koiare ure nowu tori pemegado aino. Ure pemegado nouia tori jamedu boe ekori. Boe eiamedu boe ebogodure nowu Pao Kurirewu roino duji.

Judeu doge eimijerage emearudure Jesus akoino jiboe ji dukeje eruduware puduire Jesus akoino duji. Dukodire etaidure tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo tugu baicorewuto kuri je rugadu. Mare boe etaidure Jesus ji. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage epagudure, eroiwakare tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji. Dukodire eture piji.
Boe Ewo To Imposto Mori Maku Roma Kejewu Boe Eimijera Kurirewu César Ai

Judeu doge eimijerage ere fariseu doge etudo Jesus ae. Ere ia aidure Herodes jiwuge etudo Jesus ae jamedu. Judeu doge eimijerage emagore nowu boe ji etuwo Jesus ae tunarawo ji tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe ji.

Dukodire etaregodure Jesus ae. Emagore Jesus ji. egore boe eimijeranure aki rugadu. Akare awadaru udo paga boe ji. Amearudaere boe ji boe remawu tabo. Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Awiapagakare boe ewadaru pegarewuji. Amearudaere Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Are boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji tu tu je. Awiapagakare ia boe emearudae pegarewu ji rugadu. Ca. Nuba pago bakaru umode paruduwado paromode jiboe ji? Pamode pagoe imposto mori maku Roma kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu César ai na? Pamode maku kana? Pamodukana maku kana?

Mare Jesus joruduware emearudae pegarewuji. Joruduware emearutorukare tuwadaru ji. Akore kaba kodiba tagaidure tawo iwarigu boeto tagagoino idu tabo? Ia imposto morirewu diero tori maku inai ioruduwo ji.
Ere ia diero tori maku Jesus ai. Nono Jesus akore Ioguduba je ba padure awu diero tori keje? Ioguduba ie ba padure awu diero tori keje? egore Roma kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu César ie padure keje.
Nono Jesus akore Boe rugadu. Care César oeboe maku César ai. Mare Pao Kurirewu oeboe maku Pao Kurirewu ai jamedu. Nou boe emearudure Jesus akoino duji dukodire erore ta je akoino pudui duji.
Ia Boe Eimijerage Enarare Jesus ji Pugeje
Nono ia saduceu doge etaregodure Jesus ae tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe ji jamedu. Nou saduceu doge emearudaere boe eewodumodukaie pugeje. Nono emagore Jesus ji.

egore Joruduwarewu imedunure aki. Ca mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Moisés ure jaoboe ero maku etai pamearutoruwo ji jii aino rugadu. Akore imedu bimoduie mare ore bokwaie dukeje nowu imedu uwie muguwo nowu tumana birewu oreduje apo torewo nowu birewu tumana ai.
Ca ia meri keje ime enodo padure sete. Etumana etuwie magenure pugi. Etumana mugure ia aredu apo. Mare care bire. Mare ore bokware.
Dukodire nowu uwie imedu mugure nowu aredu apo. Mare nowu imedu bire jamedu. Etore bokware. Nono uwie imedu mugure nowu aredu apo jamedu. Mare bire jamedu.
Dukodire nowu uwie ime eiamedu boe emugure nowu aredu apo rugadu. Mare eiamedu boe ewire. Etore bokware. Dukeje care nowu aredu bire jamedu.
Dukodire cedaidure cenarawo ai. Pao Kurirewu umode eewodudo pugeje dukeje duboba mugumode nowu aredu apo? Eiamedu boe emugure apo moto keje mare duboba mugumode nowu aredu apo baru tada?
Jesus makore nowu boe ewadaru jipagi. Akore taruduwa bokware. Taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu bataru padure kejewu baperaji. Taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewuji.
Birewuge eewodumode pugeje dukeje emode nono Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge emogadure. Etuwiremodukare. E t u g o g e m o d u k a r e .

Joru cere nowu enado ito mare nowu joru ukare nowu enado i kowu. Nou enado i pijire Pao Kurirewu makore Moisesji. Akore Abraão mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi. Isaque mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi. Jacó mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi.”

Pao Kurirewu makore jiwu ime ewire marigudu. Mare Pao Kurirewu makore emearutoruie pudui rugadu. Dukodire paruduware eewodure pugeje duji. Birewuge emearutorumodukare Pao Kurirewu ji. Eewodurewuge emearutorumode ji. Dukodire tamearudae ukare turugadu. Boe eewodumode pugeje rugadu.
Pao Kurirewu Bataru Kurirewu Reo

Ia joruduware Pao Kurirewu ure maku etaiwu bakaru jiwu mearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji. Joruduware Jesus mako pemegare nowu saduceu doge ewadaru jipagi duji. Mare mearudaere tunarawo Jesus ji jamedu. Akore kakojiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu remawu jiba pamode pageragu?

Jesus akore Ere pobe. Boetojiwu bataru kurirewu ure aino: “Pao Kurirewu ure mitotu je. Tamearudu kurido Pao Kurirewu ji taraga tabo, tamearudae pemegarewu tabo, tarore jiboe jamedu boe tabo. Judeu doge eiamedu boe eruduwawo awu bataru ji rugadu.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu bataru kurirewu boeto jiwu ure.
Pao Kurirewu bataru boigoduwu ure aino: “Tamearudu kurido tamedagei nono tamearudu kuri moga tai dumogadure.” Ia bataru kurirewu bokware nono awu bataru pobedu doge emogadure.

Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwu imedu makore Jesus ji pugeje. Akore awadaru ure turugadu. Joruduwarewunure aki. Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Pao Kurirewu ure mitotu je. Ia boe umodukare nono umogadure.

Boe emearudu kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji turaga tabo, tumearudae pemegarewu jamedu boe tabo. Boe emearudu kuriwo tumedagei nono tumearudu kuri moga pudui dumogadure. Boe emearutorumode awu Pao Kurirewu bataru kurirewu boeto jiwuji dukeje emearutorumode Pao Kurirewu bataru jamedu boe ji. Boe emode boe egu barogorogu bito tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai turo pegarewu boe morice. Emode boe egu barogorogu kodu kowu tuwo tomeado ce Pao Kurirewu ai. Mare emearudu kurimode Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu emearudu kurimode tumedagei rugadu. Dure pemegare nowu turo boe egu barogorogu jitu kori rugadu.

Jesus mearudure nowu imedu bataru ji. Jorudure ji joruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure ema duji. Dukodire Jesus makore ji pugeje. Akore aruduware awo akimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Ca. Amearutorudo ji rugadu. Nono boe eraga bokware tunarawo Jesus ji pugeje. Eraga bokware tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe ji rugadu.
Jesus Unarare Boe Dogei Emearudae Bagai

Jesus ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Nono unarare boe ji. Akore joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ere boe eruduwado nowu umode boe ekinorudowuji. Egore Davi onaregedu moduie ema. Mare eruduwa pemegakare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji

Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure Pao Kurirewu bataru maku Davi ai marigudu. Dukodire Davi akore Pao Kurirewu makore nowu ikimijera umode boe ekinorudowuji. Akore Amugudo woe ikana pemegarewu jagwai jii toro imode nowu jorudu pegare aiwuge etagedudo du ka.”
– Tagoino dutabo Davi akore tugimijera nuie nowu umode boe ekinorudowuce. Mare Davi onaregedu mode ema jamedu. Ca nuba nowu umode boe ekinorudowu ure? Boe emagare nono tuwiapaga tabo Jesus bataru ji.
Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Boe Ekimijerage Ero Pegare Jiboe ji

Nono Jesus ure eruduwado rugadu. Akore tagaiwo pemegado joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo pudui. Ere boe etaiwodo tugudau areia moturewu meture pudui duji. Etaidure tuwo boe epogurudo. Etumode ba kurirewu ka dukeje etaidure boe emago pemegawo pudui etaidure boe ekimijeragewo pudumi kodi. Dukodire erore aino.

Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etumode Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka dukeje emode tugeragu boe eimijera mugure kejewu iraji tumuguwo keje. Etumode boe ewadae ka dukeje etumode boe eke jeture kejewu ira ka boe etododai togwagewo boeto ji.

Eragojemode boebo dukeje emago raimode baru to boe emearuduwo tagoi tuwadaru moturewu jituji. Mare pagatu je. Ekiwogure okoge bokwarewuge aremei. Ere nowu areme okoge bokwarewuge ewai aru epiji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pegamode ei rugadu nowu ero pegarewu boe morice.
Okoge Bokwarewu Aredu Ure To Diero Rogu Maku Pao Kurirewu Ai
Jesus ure tumugudo nono Pao Kurirewu uwai tada taiwo tabo boe ji. Ere ia to diero tugu ira jagi tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai. Oe kurirewuge ere ture tuguboe kurido rugadu.
Nono ia okoge bokwarewudo aredu marenaru aregodure. Nou okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero torirogu pobedu tugu nowu ira jagi. Ure nono um centavo mogadure.

Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Awu marenaru aredu okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero jamedu boe maku dukodire ure to diero makudu kurido nowu oe kurirewuge eiamedu boe ekori.

Mare diero kurirewu ji karega inagoino. Nou oe kurirewuge ere to diero kurido Pao Kurirewu ai mare etaidukare jiwu kobo rogure ere maku. Eno diero kurire ebo kimo. Mare awu aredu ure to diero rugadu maku. Dujire inagoino.
Jesus Akore Pao Kurirewu Uwai Akedumoduie
Nono Jesus ure tudawuje Pao Kurirewu uwai piji ture joruduwadowugebo. Ia akore Ikimijera. Akaiwodo. Awu Pao Kurirewu uwai moture rugadu, rakare jamedu.

Mare Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore awu tarudure jiwu bai rakare, moture. Mare ro pegarewuge emode nowu tarudure jiwu bai kurirewu butudo rugadu. Tori tabore pawobe ere towuje marigudu. Mare ia meri keje nowu tori jamedu boe epadumodukare puaoji pugeje.
Jesus Ure Ewie Nuba Boe Mode Boei

Jesus uture Oliveira Ri ao ka. Mugu jaekare Pao Kurirewu uwai piji. Jesus ure tumugudo nono. Pedro, Tiago, João, André eiamedu boe etaregodure Jesus ae. Ia boe edukare nono ebo. Nono enarare Jesus ji.
egore kaba meri kejeba Pao Kurirewu uwai butumode, nowu akagoino jiboe jetumode pudui kuri aino na? Kaba jiba cerudumode ceruduwawo nowu akagoino jiboe jetumode pudui kuri aino duji?
Jesus makore ei. Akore taeku jado boe ekawo taekiripagado.
Boe emagamode tuwadaru pegarewu tabo. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Mare pagare egoino. Mare du inodu tabo emode boe ekiripagado rugadu.

Tamearudumode bakaru pegarewuji. Boe emode tawie boe erugoduie pui tuwaiga tabo. Boe erugodu akedukaie. Boe egomode nowu torowu boe ekorigoduie dukodie erugodu kurie pui rugadu. Mare taragado tai tamororamagadukawo. Pao Kurirewu joruduware ro pegarewuge erugoduji marigudu. Umodukare nowu erugodu tawuje epiji. Erugodumode pui tuwaiga tabo rugadu mare moto akedumodukare raga.

Boe eimijera kurirewuge erugodumode pui tugobaigaregebo. Boe eke bokwamode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire boe ewimode tuge boe ji koia. Moto magadugodumode boe jamedu boe parugajeje jamedu. Awu inagoino jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui dukeje taruduwamode moto akedumode kuri aino duji nono aredu kurijirigodu mogadure. Aredu kurijirigodure dukeje boe eruduware kuri butumode kuri aino duji. Mare aredu kurijirigodu ji karega inagoino. Boe pegamode moto ji nono iwadaru mogadure dukeje taruduwamode moto akedumode kuri aino duji. Dujire inagoino.

Taeku jado. Boe emode tugeragu tai. Emode tadugu baicorewuto. Etaiwomode ia taro pegare jiboe bagai. Emode boeto tai Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai tada. Tamearutorure i kodire boe eimijera kurirewuge emagomode tawagai. Dukejere tamagodo iwadaru pemegarewu ji ewadaru jipagi.
Boe eiamedu boe emearudumode iwu bakaru pemegarewu ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje dukeje moto akedumode.

Boe emode tadugu baicorewuto. Emagomode tai ia taro pegarewu bagai. Mare tamororamagadukaba tamagore jiboe bagai. Tamagomode mare tawadaru karega. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode tuwadaru maku tagai tamagowo ewadaru jipagi.

Boe emode tuwiemage emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Boe emode tore emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Boe etore emode tuo tuje emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo.
Tamearutorumode i kodire boe eiamedu boe erudu pegamode tai. Mare tamodukare tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji kodire imode taginorudo rugadu.
Judeu Doge Erudu Pegamode Jiboe Reo

Jesus makore kimo. Akore tarudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje taruduwamode boe pegamode kuri aino duji. Tarudumode nowu inoduji kodire inagoino tai. Boe erudumode awu bataru padure kejewu baperaji rugadu. Mare boe erudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje Judéia moto kejewuge eregodu rakamode toro tori ao ka tuwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.
Nou rakojere tuwai aogejewuge eregoduwo tuwai piji toro tori ao ka. Ekawo turemo tuwaito iaboe bagai. Etuwo tugera kedo tabo.
Nou maragodure to boepa jiwuge eregoduwo nowu to boepa piji toro nowu tori ao ka jamedu. Ekawo tugirimi tuwai ka ia tugudau areia bagai.

Nou Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe rakojemode Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje boe pegamode boe ji rugadu. Dukodire inagoino boe ji eregoduwo rugadu toro tori ao ka. Nou meri ji boe pegamode kuiarurewugei rugadu. Boe pegamode ei rugadu eroiwakare turegodu rakawo dukodi. Boe pegamode etore kugure etuje magei jamedu eroiwakare ture rakawo dukodi.
Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai biaku butukawo boe ji nowu eregodure jiwu meri keje.
Boe pegamode boe ji rugadu boe pega jamedu boe kori. Pao Kurirewu ure moto to dupiji boe erudukare awu boe pegarewu boe ji jii aino. Mare boe pegamode moto ji rugadu.

Nou boe pegamode kejewu meri makamode. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu merido biagatu je pugeje. Nou boe pegamode kejewu meri makamode rugadu dukeje boe eiamedu boe ewimode rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu boe pegamode kejewu merido biagatu je tuwo mearutorure puduiwuge edo cinorudo.
Mare boe pegamode kejewu meri aregodumode dukeje boe egomode: “Umode boe ekinorudowu aregodu. Ema reo!” Ainore boe egomode. Mare tawiapagakaba ewadaru ji. Pagare egoino.

Mare paga karega inagoino. Boe etaregodumode rugadu nowu tuwadaru tabo rugadu. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Mare pagare egoino. Egomode tumagoie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare pagare egoino. Ero rakamode boe emearutoruwo pudui Pao Kurirewu piji pagatu je. Emodukare mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge remawuge ekiripagado. Mare etaidumode tuwo mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ekiripagado nowu turo rakarewu tabo rugadu.
Dukodi care taeku jado. Pagare eroino tai. Tamearutorukaba ei. Ire tawie boe jamedu boe ji marigudu.
Imedu Onaregedu Aregodumode Pugeje
– Boe pegare moto jiboe akedumode dukeje meri joku akedumode jamedu. Ari joku akedumode jamedu.
Kuieje doge ewudumode baru piji jamedu. Baru magadugodumode rugadu.

Dukejere care boe erudumode Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode tugodu tabo boetugu aojitu duji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu ro rakarewuji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu o jorugu kurirewuji. Jorugure moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
Umode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge etudo tododai Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jiwuge ewagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Emode edo tudo pui.
Figo I Umode Boe Eruduwado

Jesus mako kimore. Akore Figo i ure taruduwado tu tu je. Figo i okurogu boture dukeje taruduware bubutumode kuri je rugadu. Tagaiwore figo iji taruduwawo bubutumode kejewu meri ji. Ainore tarore tu tu je.

Ca ire tawie nuba boemode meri jokuji nuba boemode ari jokuji. Iwo tawie. Tagaiwodo awu ire tawie jiboe jamedu boe ji emode taruduwado dubagai. Tarudumode ire tawie jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taruduwamode boe puredugodure itaregoduwo iwo boe jamedu boe akedudo. Mare bubutu ji karega inagoino. Nou itaregodumode jiwu meri jire inagoino.
Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Toro ia meri keje ia tawobe erudumode awu imagore jiboe jeture pudui duji rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu tuwimodedu otodai.
Baru akedumode. Moto akedumode jamedu. Mare iwadaru akedumodukare jii toro rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu.
Boe Eruduwakare Jesus Aregodumode Kejewu Meriji

Nono Jesus mako kimore. Akore boe eruduwakare nowu meri ji rugadu. Boe eruduwakare kaiba meri jetumode awu iwadaru jetuwo pudui. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge eruduwakare. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu joruduwakare. Tu Pao Kurirewu joruduware tu rugadu.
Taruduwakare itaregodumode kejewu meri ji. Dukodire tado tarugadu. Tagaiwodo itaregodumode dubagai.

Iromode nono ia imedu ro mogadure. Utu jaere tugiriaduwo. Ure tudugarege etu pemegado tuwaiji. Ure emaragodae maku etai. Ure ia tudugare rakojedo bai poro keje. Makore nowu tudugare ji jetu pemegawo nowu bai poroji tubaga tabo tuwagai.

Iromode nono nowu imedu ro mogadure. Dukodire inagoino tai taeku jaewo. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba itaregodumode. Itaregodumode boeco ji rakudu, meri ji rakudu, baburedugodutabo rakudu, caboecoto rakudu, merirekodutabo rakudu. Taruduwakare.
Dukodire tado tarugadu tabaga tabo iwagai. Itaregodumode taci je. Itaidukare ioruduwo tai tamearutorukare i dutabo.
Dukodi inagoino tai. Inagoino boe eiamedu boe ji. Tado tarugadu tabaga tabo iwagai.
Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Tawuje Tuwo Jesus Bito

Merimode pobe dukeje Judeu doge emode tuwadae Páscoa towuje. Nou ewadae kejere emode ia tuge amirewu tuginaiwu kowuje. Fermento metukare nowu amirewu tada. Care nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etaidure tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo bito. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaidure tuwo Jesus bito jamedu. Mare etaidukare boe eruduwawo nowu tumearudae pegarewuji.
Emagore pui. egore Pamode pageragu Jesus ji nowu Judeu doge ewadae keje dukeje boe ekorigodumode pai rugadu. Emode bato pui turo pegawo pai. Dukodire paromodukare aino ewadae keje.
Jesus Uture Boe Eda Betânia Ka

Jesus rakojere boe eda Betânia keje Simão uwai tada. Nou Simão iere Biri Pegarewu jamedu. Jesus mugure nono nowu bai tada ira keje togwage tabo. Nono ia aredu aregodure Jesus ae poarirogu tabo. Boe ere nowu poari towuje tori tabo. Nou tori iere alabastro. Roreboe mori kurirewu meture nowu poarirogu tada. Boe ere nowu roreboe towuje nardo tabo. Nono ca nowu aredu ure nowu poarirogu jado. Ure nowu roreboe redo Jesus aora joki.

Boe erudure nowu aredu roino duji dukeje iage emago pegare nowu aredu roino Jesus jituji. egore awu aredu ro pegare. Ure nowu roreboe barigu. Nou roreboe mori kurire rugadu. Boe emaragodumode jii joru akedu ka tuwo tugeragu nowu diero kurirewu ji tuwo akirodo nowu roreboe ji. Kocare ukare nowu roreboe maku diero bagai tuwo diero kurido tuwo maku marenarue doge etai? Nono emago pegare nowu areduji.
Mare Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore tagaba awu aredu pogurudo rore iduji. Rore i du moture Pao Kurirewu jakai. Mare paga karega.
Marenarue doge edumode tagabo jii toro rugadu. Tagaidumode taro pemegawo ei dukeje taro pemegado ei tagaidure jiwu meri keje. Mare imire itumode tabiji rugadu.
Awu aredu joruduware nowu inoduji dukodire ure nowu roreboe redo iogi tuwo iwiri udo turugadu ituguduwo mototo iwi keje.

Ca iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Awu aredu rore iboe akedumodukare boe etaora piji jii toro rugadu. Boe etumode moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe eruduwado emearutoruwo i iwo ekinorudo dukeje ereadodumode awu aredu rore iduji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Dukodire boe ewiagodumodukare awu aredu piji rugadu jii toro rugadu.
Judas Iscariotes Akore Tumoduie Jesus Maku Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai
Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotes uture toro nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae. Judas Iscariotes makore ei tumoduie Jesus maku etai.

Egarere nowu Judas Iscariotes makore pudui boe ji rugadu. Dukodire egore tumoduie diero maku ai. Du nowu meri pijire nowu Judas Iscariotes aiwore Jesus rore jiboe ji tuioruduwo tumode Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu meri bagai.
Jesus Okwagemode Páscoa Kejewu Boe Ekeji Ture Joruduwadowugebo

Páscoa meri boeto jiwu aregodure dukeje Judeu doge ere tagu carneiro doge kugure ewido tuwo tuge pemegado nono turo mogadure tuwaduwo Páscoaji. Nou meri ji nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kaiba cemode page pemegado pawo kowuje, pawaduwo Páscoaji?

Nono Jesus ure tugeragu imei. Ere pobe. Ure joruduwadowugenure emage. Makore ei. Akore tadudo toro ba kurirewu ka. Tagaregodumode toro dukeje ia imedu aregodumode tadogi ia pori po tabo. Tadudo nowu imedu rekodaji.

Umode turemo ia baito dukeje tanarado nowu uwaire bai cewuji ia paedumodewu bagai. Tagagodo aino: “Pagimijera aidure ia tumugumodewu bagai togwagewo Páscoa kejewu boe ekeji ture joruduwadowugebo nowu boe edurewu tada.”
Tamagomode aino dukeje nowu uwaire bai cewu umode tarududo ia boe edu tadawu bai pemegarewuji. Nou bai pemegamode rugadu pagwagewo Páscoa kejewu pageji. Nonore tamode page pemegado.
Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge pobedu doge eture nowu ba kurirewu ka. Erudure nowu boe ji nono Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Nono ere tuge pemegado tuwaduwo Páscoaji nowu bai tada rugadu.
Nou boeco ji Jesus aregodure nouia ture joruduwadowugebo nowu bai ka nowu ime pobedu doge etae. Dukodire enodo padure doze nono Jesus apo.
Emugure nono ira keje togwage tabo rugadu. Dukeje Jesus makore ei. Akore iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Tagwagere itabo woe mare ia tagi tamode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.
Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ekiarigodure. Dukodire enarare Jesus ji tu tu puregodaji. egore i na akagoino? Imi na?
Jesus akore Tare doze. Mare umode tuge amirewu pegodo nowu carneiro kaguru tabowu emare umode imagu boe ekimijerage pegarewuge etai.

Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie iwimoduie duji. Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje. Aino care iwimode nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koia. Mare boe pegamode rugadu nowu ure imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwuji. Botumodukare dukeje boe pegamodukare ji. Mare boture. Aino care umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai dukodire boe pegamode ji rugadu.
Jesus Okwagere Ture Joruduwadowugebo

Ca enogwage kimore. Jesus ure tugeragu tuge amirewuji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu amirewu paru tabo. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado dukeje ure pedo nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tagwagedo awuji. Ikodu reo tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje.
Nono Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu. Nono imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu uva kuru paru tabo. Dukejere ure pedo ei jamedu ekuduwo ce.

Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Iku redodumode boe eiamedu boe ero pegarewu morice. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu tumoduie turo maiwu maku boe etai tuwo boe ekinorudo. Aino care iku umode nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetudo pudui rugadu. Nou iku koiare umode mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge etawuje tuwobece tuwo ekinorudo rugadu.

Mare iwo tawie. Ikudumodukare awu vinho kuruce pugeje jii toro itaregodumode mato ibagi pugeje du ka. Itaregodumode pugeje dukeje boe eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewu mode imi. Nono ikudumode vinho kuru maiwuce tagabo.
Jesus akoino dukeje urare Pao Kurirewu bataru tabo nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Nono ere tudawuje nowu ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Oliveira Ri ao ka.

Jesus Makore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Bagai Getsêmani Moto Keje
Nono Jesus aregodure ture joruduwadowugebo ia iguru jeturewu ka. Nou iguru iere Getsêmani. Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tamugudo woe. Imagomode baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai.

Makore nowu ture tugeragu jiwuge ji. Akore ikiarigodu rakare rugadu. Rakare tuwo iwido rugadu. Ca tadu rugadu woe tamagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai.
Nono Jesus ure tudaru gu epiji. Nono ure tubu jodo moto keje tumagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Makore Pao Kurirewu bagai boe pegakawo pudui. Makore Pao Kurirewu bagai uwo tumearudae mekido.
Akore iogwa Kurirewunure aki. Aromode boe jamedu boe ji. Boe ero pegamode idu utudo piji. Mare ukawo nono itaidu mogadure. Mare uwo nono akaidu mogadure.

Nono Jesus ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Mare kocare enudure. Nono Jesus makore Pedro bagai. Akore Simão Pedro! Anudure? Amagodo Pao Kurirewu bagai itabowu hora uwo mitotu je mare kocare anudure kuri je.

Nono Jesus makore eiamedu boe ji. Ere pobe metia bokware. Akore tamearudae pemegare. Mare taraga bokware. Aino ca tanudukaba pugeje. Tamagodo itabo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.
Nono Jesus ure tudaru gu epiji pugeje. Nono makore baru to nono tumago mogadure boeto ji pugeje.
Nono Jesus ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae pugeje. Jorudure ei enudu kimore duji. Norire ekuji rugadu dukodire enudure rugadu. Nono eruduwakare tumagomode jiboe ji pugeje.

Nono Jesus uture epiji pugeje tumagowo baru to pugeje. Dukejere care ure tugirimi etae pugeje. Nono makore ei. Akore tanudu kimonure rugadu kana? Urugadu. Aino care imagudumode boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai kuri aino rugadu.
Ca taragojedo. Pugeje. Nou ure imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu aregodu. Paduwo togi.
Boe Ekimijera Pegarewuge Ere Tugeragu Jesus ji

Jesus mako kimore dukeje Judas Iscariotes aregodure etae. Jesus ure joruduwadowunure ema. Aregodure boebo. Nou boe etaregodure tariga kurirewu tabo. Etaregodure rago tabo. Boe ekimijerage ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai.
Nou Judas Iscariotes makore nowu boe ji tugimadumoduie Jesus apo, tumoduie togwa to je koduto tuwo nowu boe pegarewuge erududo taidure tuwo tugeragu jiwunure ema duji.
Dukodire Judas Iscariotes uture kuri Jesus ae rugadu. Ukimadure apo rugadu. Akore joruduwarewunure aki. Nono Judas Iscariotes ure togwa to Jesus je koduto.
Nono nowu boe pegarewuge ere tugeragu Jesus ji turaga tabo.
Mare ia Jesus ure joruduwadowu ure tugeragu tariga kurirewuji. Ure ia imedu bija kado. Nou imedu nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewu utugarenure ema.

Mare Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore ire boe emearudae pegado kana emearutorukawo tugimijeragei kana? Ro pegarewu karegure imi. Kocare tagaregodure tariga kurirewu tabo rago tabo tawo tageragu i nono taro moga ro pegarewuge eidu mogadure.

Iragojere tagabo meri jamedu ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Ire boe eruduwado nono. Mare tagare tageragu i. Mare aino care Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu. Tagaregodure tawo tageragu i nono Pao Kurirewu bataru mogadure.
Dukodire Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe eregodure Jesus piji.
Nou boe pegarewuge eture Jesus apo dukeje ia iparedu uture eregodaji. Dukodire nowu boe pegarewuge etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji jamedu. Nou iparedu ukudau areiare mitotu je.
Mare uture piji tuwo cinorudo nowu boe pegarewuge epiji tuwiri kedo tabo.
Jesus Rakojere Judeu Doge Ekimijerage Egorai

Nou boe ere Jesus reko toro Judeu doge ekimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewunure ema. Nouia Judeu doge ekimijerage edu nono jamedu. Ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijeragenure iage. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugenure iage. Boe eimijerage paru towugenure iage.
Pedro kodu jaere boe ji tudu tabo Jesus rekodaji boe erudukawo pudui. Nono aregodure nowu Judeu doge ekimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Nou uwai kejere ure tumugudo nono tugobaigaregebo joru okwai.

Nou bai ja tadare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage edure. Nou Jerusalém kejewu Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe edure nono jamedu. Eiamedu boe etaiwore ia Jesus ro pegarewu bagai. Ewiapagare batrarodurewuge ewadaru ji taiwo tabo nowu Jesus ro pegarewu bagai. Etaidure tuwo Jesus bito. Mare erudukare ia Jesus ro pegarewuji.
Boe egore Jesus ro pegaie. Mare ewadaru kodukare puregodaji.
Nono ia boe ewadrarodure pugeje Jesus roji.

egore cemearudure awu imedu bataru ji. Akore ime eie Pao Kurirewu uwai towuje. Mare tumoduie Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewu butudo dukeje merimoduie pobe metia bokware tuwo nowu bai rakojedo pugeje. Ia ime karega. Pudumie tumoduie Pao Kurirewu uwai rakojedo pugeje.
Mare awu ime ewadaru kodukare puregodaji jamedu.
Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure turagojedo. Makore Jesus ji. Akore amagomodukare nowu ewadaru jipagi kana? Boe rugadu ji kana egoino rugadu?
Mare Jesus makokare boe ji. Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewu unarare Jesus ji pugeje. Akore umode boe ekinorudowunure aki? Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki?

Jesus akore Imi rugadu. Mare iwo tawie Imedu Onaregedu romode jiboe ji. Awu inodu otobiji tarudumode i imugure Pao Kurirewu ukana pemegarewu jagwai duji. Tarudumode i ire irawuje baru piji boetugu tabo duji.

Ca nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure tugudau areia mega bowuje tugorigodure dukodi. Dukodire makore tumedage boe eimijeragei. Akore ca. Pamearudure awu Jesus bataru pegarewu ji rugadu.

Unure tudo nono Pao Kurirewure. Pagare akoino. Mako peganure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dukodi care nuba tamearudaere? Nuba paromode ji? Nou boe eimijerage eiamedu boe ere tumearudaedo nono nowu boe eimijera kurirewu mearudae mogadure. Emearutorukare Jesus akoinoduji. Egore pagaie akoino. Jesus ro pegaie rugadu. Tumoduie Jesus bito.
Nono ere todoguru barigu Jesus joki. Ere areia kogudo Jesus jegajeje. Nono ere boeto Jesus ji. Egokodure ji. egore ioguduba roino ai? Nono nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu ji pugeje tuwo boeto ji.
Pedro Makore Tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji
Pedro rakoje kimore nono nowu bawadu keje. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewu utugare aredu kodure nono.
Nou aredu jorudure Pedro ji. Pedro mugure nowu joru okwai ture tugera urudo dutabo. Nou aredu aiwore ji. Akore ature Nazaré kejewu Jesus apo jamedu.
Mare Pedro akore Boro. Ioruduwakare kaba jiba akagoino. Nono Pedro uture nowu bawadu kejewu bai poro ka. Nono ia kagariga kudugodure.
Nono nowu aredu makore ia boe ji. Akore jowu imedu ia Jesus ure joruduwadowunure ema rugadu.

Mare Pedro akore pugeje tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji. Ca Pedro rakoje kimore nono ji je. Dukejere ia boe emagore Pedro ji pugeje. egore Galiléia moto kejewunure aki nono Jesus mogadure. Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowunure aki rugadu.
Mare Pedro mako pegare ei tumagomodukaie boe remawu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu uiago boe pegado pudui. Akore ioruduwakare nowu tagagoino jiwu imeduji rugadu.

Care rore puku kagariga kudugodure pugeje. Dukodire Pedro biabuture Jesus makore puduiwu tuwadaru keje. Jesus makore Pedro ji makomoduie tuioruduwakaie pudui dukeje nowu kagariga kudugodumoduie rugadu. Pedro makomoduie tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji dumode pobe metia bokware rugadu. Aino ca Pedro biabuture nowu Jesus bataru keje rugadu jeture pudui duji rugadu. Dukodire kiarigodure turo pegarewuji. Dukodire ragudure.
Pilatos Aiwore Jesus Ro Pegarewu Bagai

N o u b a r o g w a t o , barogwakododutabo nowu Judeu doge enomea makudure aiwuge eimijerage, nouia Judeu doge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emagore pui tuwo tumearudae tawuje tuwo Jesus bito rugadu. Nono ere Jesus kogudo. Dukejere ere Jesus reko nowu boe eimijera governador Pilatos bagai rugadu.
Etaregodure Jesus apo Pilatos ae dukeje Pilatos unarare Jesus ji. Akore boe rugadu kana? Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu kana? Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino.
Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emago pegare Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu Pilatos biagai. Ewadrarodure Jesus rore jiboe ji.
Dukodire Pilatos makore Jesus ji pugeje. Akore egore aro pegaie. Kocare amagokare boe ji ewadaru jipagi.
Mare Jesus makokare boe ji pugeje. Dukodire Pilatos joruduwakare nuba turomode Jesus ji pugeje.
Egore Jesus Bitoduiago Rugadu

Judeu doge ewadae Páscoa kejere Pilatos ure ia ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji Judeu doge eroiaji. Judeu doge emagomode ia ro pegarewu ieji dukeje Pilatos umode nowu ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje.

Ro pegarewuge emagare baicorewu tada nowu joruji. Iage ekorigodure pui ba kurirewu tada dukodire ere ia imedu bito. Dukodire eragojere nono baicorewu tada. Ia ro pegarewu imedu rakojere ebo jamedu. Iere Barrabás.
Aino care boe emagore Pilatoji uwo ia ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje turoiaji.
Dukodire Pilatos makore ei. Akore tagaidure iwo awu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje? Jesus jire nowu Pilatos akoino.

Pilatos joruduware nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emearudae pegare Jesus jituji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo tu pudui rugadu. Dukodire etaregodure Jesus apo Pilatos ae boe emearutorukawo Jesus ji pugeje. Mare Pilatos joruduware Jesus ro pegarewu bokwaie duji. Dukodire aidure Jesus utuwo pugeje. Aidukare turo pegawo Jesus ji.
Mare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere boe ero jodo. Dukodire nowu boe emagore Pilatoji uwo ro pegarewu imedu Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje.
Mare Pilatos makore ei. Akore nuba iromode awu tagagoino Judeu doge eimijera kurirewuji?
Nou boe doge ekudugodure. egore nou Jesus bito! Bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje!
Pilatos akore Kodiba tagagoino? Ro pegarewu pa? Mare ewiapagakare ji. Ere tugudu rakado. egore bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu!

Pilatos aidure tuwo nowu boe doge ewudugugo. Dukodire rore nono etaidu mogadure. Ure Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje. Dukejere ure tugobaigarege edo boeto Jesus ji tapira biri iku tabo. Nono ure Jesus maku etai ewo bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje.
Tugobaigarege Egokodure Jesus ji
Tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Jesus ji. Ere turemo apo nowu tugimijera Pilatos uwaito. Nono emagore nouia tugobaigarege ewagai. Ere bato pui nono Jesus ae.

Nono ere ia boe eimijera kurirewu ukudau areia moturewu tugu Jesus ji. Nou areia kaworu dugunure. Ere ia boe eimijera kurirewu atadawu towuje. Ere nowu atadawudo botoguruce. Dukejere ere tugu Jesus aoto atadawuwo ema.
Nono emago pegare Jesus ji. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki. Boe pemegawo ai awikawo jii toro. Mare tuwudorekeadae tabore egoino Jesus ji.
Nono ere ipo to Jesus aoraji. Ere todoguru to ji. Ere tubu jodo Jesus jokorai. Ere tuie jodo mototo tuwudorekeadae pegarewu tabo.

Ere tumago pegarewu akedudo dukeje ere nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ukudau areia moturewu tawuje Jesus piji. Ere Jesus ukudau areia tugu ji pugeje. Nono ere tugeragu Jesus ji tuduwo apo Jerusalém piji tuwo bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje toro ture boe ewidodurewu ka.
Boe Ere Jesus Bu Ipo Padure Pugajejewu Keje

Eture Jesus apo dukeje tugobaigarege ere tugeragu ia imeduji oreduwo nowu Jesus bitodumode kejewu ipo tabo. Nou imedu iere Simão. Aregodure ipoguru piji ba kurirewu ka. Cirene ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Onaregedu imedu iere Alexandre. Ia onaregedu imedu iere Rufo. Tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Simãoji oreduwo nowu ipo tabo.
Nono eture Jesus apo toro ia tori ao ka. Ewadaru tabo nowu tori iere Gólgota. Boe ewadaru tabo iere: “Boe ewirewuge etaora ra jeta reo.”
Ere ia jorubo barigu vinho kuruto. Nou jorubo iere mirra. Nono ere nowu vinho kuru maku Jesus ai kuduwo ce. Mare Jesus aidukare tuguduwo ce.
Nono tugobaigarege ere Jesus bu ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Ere Jesus ukudau areia pedo pui. Ere tuwadumode tabowu torirogu barigu tuioruduwawo ioguduba umode tugeragu Jesus ukudau areiaji.
Meri jeture toro baru kugajeje dukeje ere bu ipo padure pugajejewu keje.
Ere atugoreboe bu ipo keje Jesus aora bukajeje. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu reo.
Ere ia ro pegarewu ime pobedu doge emugudo nono Jesus apo jamedu nowu meri ji. Ia rakojere Jesus kana pemegarewu jagwai. Metia rakojere Jesus kana pegarewu jagwai jamedu.
Boe etaregodure nono dukeje ere taora paradudo. Emago pegare Jesus ji. egore akagore amoduie Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo mare merimoduie pobe metia bokware dukeje amoduie rakojedo pugeje.
Kocare amodukare arawuje nowu ipo piji? Ca arawuje. Amodukare akinorudo nowu ipo piji rugadu?

Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emagore pui tugodakagiriwo Jesus ji. egore awu imedu akore tumoduie boe ekinorudo. Mare roiwakare tuwo cinorudo. Kocare umodukare boe ekinorudo rugadu.

Umode turawuje awu ipo piji dukeje pamearutorumode ji. Kocare umode boe ekinorudowu karegure ema pugeje. Israel doge eimijera kurirewu karegure ema rugadu. Nou ro pegarewuge epadure ipo keje Jesus apowuge emago pegare Jesus ji nowu boe eimijera pegarewugebo jamedu.
Jesus Bire
Meri aregodure pagaia ka dukeje boecodure moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boecodure rugadu. Nou boeco kodure kuri toro nowu três hora ka. Nou três hora otobiji baru aregodure nono tumogadure pugeje.
Dukeje care Jesus makore tugudu tabo tuwadaru tabo. Akore eloí. Eloí. Lemá sabactani? Boe ewadaru tabore akore Pao Kurirewu. Pao Kurirewu. Kodiba are akera ra ipiji?
Boe emearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji dukeje egore tawiapagado. Jesus kudugodure Elias bagai.

Ia imedu rekodure ia esponja tabo. Ure nowu esponja pegodo vinho kuru tabo. Nono aregodure tabo Jesus ae. Ure nowu esponja kogudo ipo oto tabo. Nono ure nowu esponja raido nowu ipo tabo toro Jesus okwa ka. Akore Pabagamode Elias bagai uwo Jesus rawuje nowu ipo piji.
Nono Jesus kudugodu rakare tugiarigodure dukodi dukeje bire.
Nou areia kurirewu bararere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tadawu ure tuwowuje nowu bai ja oto piji moto ka jamedu.
Ia tugobaigarege eimijera rakoje puredure nowu Jesus padure kejewu ipoji. Jorudure Jesus bire duji. Akore boe rugadu. Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure ema rugadu.
Areme eragojere nono jamedu. Etaiwo jaere Jesus ae. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Metago iere Salomé. Ia etumedago iere Maria jamedu. Nou Maria ore ime ere pobe. Ia iere Tiago. Umana iere José.
Jesus rakoje kimore Galiléia moto keje dutabo nowu areme emearutorure ji. Aino eragojere nowu Jesus birewu keje. Ia areme etaregodure Jerusalém piji turagojewo nono jamedu.
Boe Ere Jesus Tugu Tori Poroto

Merirekodutabo José aregodure. Arimatéia ba kurirewu kejewunure ema. Boe eimijeranure ema jamedu. Boe etaidure ji. Emearutorure ji. Nou José upagare Pao Kurirewu bagai boe eiamedu boe eimijerawo ema. Aino care Jesus bire sexta feira meri keje. Dukodire José uture boe eimijera Pilatos bagai tumagowo ji. Pogurukare tumagowo ji. Aidure tuwo Jesus tugu mototo.

Pilatos okeare Jesus bire kuri aino duji. Makore tugobaigarege eimijera bagai tunarawo ji Jesus bagai. Nou tugobaigarege eimijera akore Jesus bie rugadu. Nono Pilatos akore Kocare Jesus bire kuri je. Nono Pilatos makore Joseji uwo tugeragu Jesus ji uwo tugu mototo.

Nono José ure akirodo ia boe ekudau areia moturewuji. Uture tabo birewu Jesus ae. Ure Jesus rawuje nowu ipo piji. Ure Jesus upodo nowu areia tabo. Nono ure Jesus tugu ia tori poro maiwuto nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Ere nowu tori porodo tuwo ia birewuge etugu nono. Mare ekare ia birewuge etugu nowu tori poroto raga. Ca José ure Jesus tugu nowu tori poroto dukeje ure ia tori kurirewu bu nowu tori poro je keje tuwo miwuje.
Areme eku kidure rore aino duji. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Metago iere Maria. José ucenure ema. Emagere eruduware kaiba Jesus padure.
Jesus Jewodure Pugeje
Sábado boeco ji nowu areme ere tudawuje tuwo akirodo roreboe ji tuwo reko Jesus biri joki. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Metago iere Maria. Tiago ucenure ema. Metago iere Salomé.
Domingo meri ji, ca boecoto eture nowu tori poro ka.

Epuredugodure dukeje emagore pui. egore nuba paromode pawo nowu tori poro jado? Tori kurirewu padure nowu tori poro je keje. Paragakare pawo nowu tori kurirewu tawuje nowu tori poro piji. Etaregodure dukeje etaiwore mare nowu tori kurirewu padukare nowu tori poro je keje pugeje.
Dukodire ere turemo nowu tori poroto rugadu. Nono erudure ia ipareduji. Mugure nono nowu tori poro ja tada. Ukudau areia kigadu maere ji rugadu. Dukodire care epagudugodure nowu ipareduce.

Nou iparedu makore ei. Akore tabagudukaba. Ioruduware kaba bagaiba taroino taemaru tabo. Tagaiwonure Nazaré pijiwu bitodurewu Jesus bagai. Ca rakojekare woe pugeje. Tagaiwodo padure kejewu toriji. Jewodure pugeje.
Tadudo pugeje toro Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewagai, Pedro bagai jamedu. Tawo ewie Jesus utumoduie etododai Galiléia moto ka. Torore boe erudumoduie pudui. Ure ewie marigudu erudumoduie pudui toro.
Nono nowu areme eregodure nowu tori poro piji tubagudu koia. Emororamagadure nowu tuiorudure jiboe ji rugadu. Dukodire emagokare boe ji boe ewiagai.
Jesus Ure Maria Madalena Jorududo Pudui

Domingo meri ji ca boecoto Jesus jewodure pugeje. Nono ure Maria Madalena jorududo pudui. Marigudu ure nowu bope doge etuwaire ewarigu nowu Maria Madalena piji. Nou bope doge etuwaire enodo padure sete.
Aino care ure Maria Madalena jorududo pudui dukeje Maria Madalena uture nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etae tuwo ewie tuiorudure Jesus jituji. Emage edure tuwai keje tragudu tabo tugiarigodu tabo.
Maria Madalena ure ewie. Akore Jesus jewodure pugeje. Iorudure ji rugadu. Mare emearutorukare Maria Madalena makore jiboe ji.
Jesus Ure Ime Pobedu Doge Erududo Pudui
Ia ime pobedu doge eture tuwai piji ipoguru ka. Jesus ure joruduwadowugenure emage. Nono Jesus ure erududo pudui.
Dukodi care ere tugirimi nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewagai tuwo ewie tuiorudure Jesus jituji. Mare emearutorukare nowu ime pobedu doge egoino jiboe ji.
Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Eiamedu Boe Erududo Pudui

Dukeje care Jesus ure ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe erududo pudui. Enodo padure onze. Enogwagere dukeje Jesus aregodure etae. Mako rakare ei. Emearutorukare nouia tumedage ewadaru ji. Nou emedage erudure Jesus ji dukeje ere tumedage ewie mare emearutorukare. Dukodire Jesus mako rakare ei.
Dukodi care makore ei pugeje. Akore tadudo moto jamedu boe parugajeje tawo boe eiamedu boe ewie iwadaru pemegarewuji.
Imode mearutorure iwuge eiamedu boe ekinorudo. Emearutorumode i dukeje etao pegododumode dukeje imode ekinorudo. Mare mearutorukare iwuge imode ewarigu boe pegarewuto.

Imode mearutorure iwuge ero rakado. Emode bope doge etuwaire etawuje boe epiji. Mare turaga tabo karega. Ikie tabore imearudae tabore eroino. Emagomode boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji jamedu. Boe erudumode eroino duji dukeje eruduwamode iragojere ebo duji.
Emode tugeragu awagei mare boe pegamodukare ei. Ekudumode jorubo pegarewuce mare boe pegamodukare ei. Emode tugera bu kogodurewuge ewugeje dukeje nowu kogodurewuge epemegagodumode jamedu.
Jesus Ruture Baruto
Jesus ure tumago akedudo nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje ruture baru to. Aregodure toro baru to dukeje mugure Pao Kurirewu kana pemegarewu jagwai. Aino Pagimijera kurirewunure ema rugadu.

Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Pagimijera Jesus ure ero rakado. Dukodi care boe eruduware boe jokodu jirabodu boe egoino.
